sa: अथाङ्गदो मृत्युसमानवेगं संवर्त्य मुष्टिं गिरिशृङ्गकल्पम्। निपातयामास तदा महात्मा नसन्तकस्योरसि वालिपुत्रः॥
en: Then Vāli's son, the high-souled Angada clenching his fist into a blow resembling Death itself in energy, and like to a mountain-peak, let it descend on the chest of Narāntaka.

sa: विक्रमेणोपपन्नश्च यथा विष्णुर्महायशाः। सत्यवादी मधुरवाग् देवो वाचस्पतिर्यथा॥
en: He is gifted with prowess like to the greatly famed Vişnu, truthful and sweet-speeched like to Vacaspati. (The god of speech)

sa: मुद्गरैः पट्टिशैः शूलैः प्रासतोमरपाणयः। परिवार्य हनूमन्तं सहसा तस्थुरग्रतः॥
en: And accoutred in maces, axes, and javelins, and bearing bearded darts and lances in their hands, they suddenly surrounded Hanuman and remained before him.

sa: तिष्ठ किं प्राकृतैरेभिर्हरिभिस्त्वं करिष्यसि। अस्मिन्वज्रसमस्पर्श प्रासं क्षिप ममोरसि॥
en: Stay! What shall you do with these inferior monkeys? This prasa, having the feel of the thunder-bolt, do you hurl at my heart itself.

sa: यावद्धि केशग्रहणात्सुहृद्भिः समेत्य सर्वैः परिपूर्णकामैः। निगृह्य राजा परिरक्षितव्यो भूतैर्यथा भीमबलैर्गृहीतः॥
en: As a person possessed by fearfully strong ghosts, is saved by his friends pulling him by his hair, attaining your desire you desire you should, assembling together, rescuer the king.

sa: पुलस्त्येनापि संत्यतो राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् । परिष्वक्तः कृतातिथ्यो लज्जमानो विनिर्जितः॥
en: And being released by the influence of Pulastya, the highly powerful Daśānana, the king of Raksasas, accepted his hospitality and being embraced by him, returned home ashamed.

sa: निशम्य यत्नेन विभीषणस्य। ततो महात्मा वचनं बभाषे तत्रेन्द्रजिनैर्ऋतयूथमुख्यः॥
en: Hearing carefully the words of Vibhīşaņa, gifted with the intelligence of the lord of speech, the high-souled Indrajit, the leader of demons, spoke, saying.

sa: तासां चन्द्रोपमैर्वक्त्रैः शुभैललितकुण्डलैः। विराजत विमानं तन्नभस्तारागणैरिव ॥
en: With their fair countenances resembling the Moon, graced with comely ear-rings, that terrace looked beautiful, like the welking embellished with stars.

sa: नन्दनेऽप्सरसः सप्त महेन्द्रानुचरा दश॥ अनेन भक्षिता ब्रह्मऋषयो मानुषास्तथा।
en: And, O Brāhmaṇa, even Apsarās in Nandana, ten attendants of Mahendra, as well as sages and human beings, have been devoured by this one.

sa: क्षत्रबन्धुं सदानार्य रामः परमदुर्मतिः। भक्तं भ्रातरमचैव त्वां द्रक्ष्यति हतं मया॥ वित्रस्तकवचं भूमौ व्यपविद्धशरासनम्। हृतोत्तमाङ्गं सौमित्रे त्वामद्य निहतं मया।॥
en: This very day shall the exceedingly wicked Råma behold you, who are the friend of Kș atriyas and devoted to your brother, and who ėver bear yourself ignobly, slain by me; today see you, O Sumitra's son, slain by me, with your armour fallen off your person, your bow broken, and your head severed.

sa: गच्छैनं राक्षसं वीरं योऽसौ तुरगमास्थितैः। भक्षयन्तं परबलं क्षिप्रं प्राणैर्वियोजय।८२॥
en: Go against this heroic Raksasas that is mounted on a steed; and speedily deprive of life that one who is devouring up the ranks of his foes.

sa: यश्चैष जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टं दीप्तं सधूमं पिरघं प्रगृह्य। आयाति रक्षोबलकेतुभूतो योऽसौ निकुम्भोऽद्भुतवीरकर्मा॥
en: That one is Nikumbha of wondrous valorous deeds (in battle) that, grasping a flaming and smoky bludgeon embellished with gold and diamonds, come-a very banner of the entire Rāksasa host.

sa: शरनिर्भिन्नगात्रास्ते शूलनिर्भिन्नदेहिनः। जगृहुस्ते द्रुमांस्तत्र शिलाश्च हरियूथपाः॥
en: Those monkey-leaders, their bodies pierced with shafts and their persons riven with darts, took up trees and crags.

sa: स बभूव महाभीमो नरराक्षससिंहयोः। विमर्दस्तुमुलो युद्धे परस्परजयैषिणोः॥
en: And exceedingly dreadful was the encounter that took place between those leonine man and Rākşasa, each eager to conquer the other.

sa: तामिङ्गितज्ञः संप्रेक्ष्य बभाषे जनकात्मजाम्॥ प्रदेहि सुभगे हारं यस्य तुष्टासि भामिनि ।
en: Beholding that (Rāma) capable of reading the gestures, spoke to the daughter of king Janaka, saying, "O fortunate and beautiful lady, do you confer this necklace upon him with whom you are pleased."

sa: न तावत्सदृशं नाम सचिवैरुपजीविभिः। विप्रियं नृपतेर्वक्तुं निग्रहे प्रग्रहे प्रभोः।७।।
en: That counsellors subsisting (on the wealth of their master and sovereign), should say aught disagreeable to him, whether they meet with his favour or disfavour-is not meet.

sa: तृणबिन्दुस्तु राजर्षिस्तपसा द्योतितप्रभः। ध्यानं विवेश तच्चापि अपश्यदृषिकर्मजम्॥
en: Thereat the Rajarsi, Trinabindu, having a live effulgence through asceticism, entered into contemplation, and saw the consequence of the sage's act.

sa: धर्मिष्ठ त्वं यथा वत्स तथा चैतद्भविष्यति। यस्माद्राक्षसयोनौ ते जातस्यामित्रनाशन॥ नाधर्मे जायते बुद्धिरमरत्वं ददामि ते। इत्युक्त्वा कुम्भकर्णाय वरं दातुमवस्थितम्॥
en: As you are virtuous, so all this shall come to pass on your behalf. And inasmuch as in spite of your having been born in the Rākṣasa race, your thoughts, ( destroyer of enemies, do not originate in sin, I confer on the immortality. Having said this, he intended to grant boons to Kumbhakarna.

sa: ततः संधाय सौमित्रिः शरानाशीविषोपमान्। मुमोच विशिखांस्तस्मिन्सानिव विषोल्बणान्॥
en: Then fixing arrows (on his bow) resembling venomous snakes, he let go those keen shafts, like to serpents furnished with poison.

sa: एवमुक्तोऽथ वैदेह्या राघवः प्रत्युवाच ताम्। एवमस्त्विति किष्किन्धां प्राप्य संस्थाप्य राघवः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehi Rāghava replied-saying, "this shall be done" and getting at Kişkindhă he stopped the car. And having beheld the car stationed he spoke to Sugriva, saying.

sa: न जीवन्यास्यते शत्रुस्तव बाणवशं गतः। नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्य सिंहस्येव महागजः॥
en: Your foe coming within the sway of your shafts will not hence, living, even like a mighty elephant coming before a sharp-toothed roaring lion.

sa: स गत्वा नगरी लङ्काससाद विभीषणम्। मानितस्तेन धर्मेण पृष्टश्चागमनं प्रति॥
en: Going to the city of Lankā, he presented himself before Vibhīşaņa. And having received him with honour, he asked him as to the cause of his visit.

sa: यथा पुष्करपत्रेषु पतितास्तोयबिन्दवः। न श्लेषमभिगच्छन्ति तथानार्येषु सौहृदम्॥
en: As the drops of water do not last long on the leaves of lotuses, so is the friendship with unworthy persons.

sa: उताहो हतवीर्यास्ते बभूवुः पृथिवीक्षितः। बहिष्कृता वरास्त्रैश्च बहवो निर्जिता नृपाः॥
en: Were all the kings then shorn of their strength and prowess? And many kings I (hear) were vanquished an driven out by him with various excellent weapons.

sa: छिन्नवर्मतनुत्राणा राक्षसा वानरैर्हताः। रुधिरं प्रसृतास्तत्र रससारमिव दुमाः॥
en: The Rākşasas, slain by the monkeys, having their mail and defence for the body rent, bled like to trees exuding sap.

sa: हरयो राक्षसाश्चैव शेरते गां समाश्रिताः। कङ्कगृध्रबलाढ्याश्च गोमायुकुलसंकुलाः॥
en: Monkeys and Rākşasas lay down in the field, thronged with numbers of Kankas, and vultures, and swarming with flock of jackals.

sa: चिरात्सुमाली व्यचरद्रसातलं स राक्षसो विष्णुभयादितस्तदा। पुत्रैश्च पौत्रैश्च समन्वितो बली ततस्तु लङ्कामवसद्धनेश्वरः॥
en: And that powerful Rākṣasa, Sumāli, afflicted with the fear of Vişnu, along with his sons and grand-sons for a long time ranged the nether regions, and the lord of riches resided in Lankā.

sa: क्वार्जुनो नृपतिः शीघ्रं सम्यगाख्यातुमर्हथ। रावणोऽहमनुप्ताप्तो युद्धेप्सुनुवरेण ह॥
en: Where is the king Arjuna? Do you speedily tell me; I am Rāvana, I have come to fight with your king.

sa: परमापद्गतस्यापि धर्मे मम मतिर्भवेत्॥ अशिक्षितं च ब्रह्मास्त्रं भगवन्प्रतिभातु मे।
en: May my mind remained fast fixed on righteousness, even when I shall happen to fall into high peril; and may I attain Brahma knowledge without any instructions!

sa: सर्वलोकेश्वरस्येह कृत्वा विप्रियमीदृशम्। रामस्य राजसिंहस्य दुर्लभं तव जीवितम्।॥
en: Having done such a wrong to the foremost of all creatures-even to that lion of a monarch, Rāma, your life is in high peril.

sa: रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा हर्षमुपागता। नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिश्चास्याः सदा त्वयि॥
en: Hearing of the friendship between you and Sugrīva she was greatly delighted. And she has her respect for you unshaken and all her actions are for you.

sa: तौ शरौषैस्तथाकीर्णो निकृत्तकवचध्वजौ। सृजन्तौ रुधिरं चोष्णं जलं प्रस्रवणाविव॥
en: And covered with vollies of shafts, with their armour and banners rent, they drew each other's warm blood flowing like water from a fountain.

sa: अहो धिङ्मन्निमित्तोऽयं विनाशो राजपुत्रयोः। अथवा पुत्रशोकेन अहत्वा रामलक्ष्मणौ॥ विधमिष्यति मां रौद्रो राक्षसः पापनिश्चयः।
en: Alas! O fie! For me those princes have met with destruction. Or it may be that not without slaying Rāma and Laksmana, this terrific Rākşasa having his heart set on sin, from grief for his son will slay me.

sa: अन्याः पुनर्हर्म्यतमोपविष्टास्तत्र प्रियाङ्के सुसुखोपविष्टाः। भर्तुः परा धर्मपरा निविष्टा ददर्श धीमान् मदनोपविष्टाः॥
en: The sensible Hanumān saw there other females scated in stately halls, lying in happiness on the laps of their lovers, beloved of their lords-intent on virtue, married women, under the influence of Madana.

sa: सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं ज्ञात्वापि ध्यानमास्थितम्। प्रणतश्च प्रहृष्टश्च प्राप्तां सीतां न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Thereupon approaching the high-souled Rama, who, bearing informed of (Vibhisana's approach) was engaged in meditation, Vibhīşaņa bowing down and delighted communicated to him the arrival of Sită.

sa: धयं यशस्यमायुष्यं राज्ञां च विजयावहम्। आदिकाव्यमिदं चार्ष पुरा वाल्मीकिना कृतम्॥
en: This sacred Epic, the first of its kind, affording piety, fame, and long life, and describing the conquest of tire kings, was composed by Vālmīki in the days of yore.

sa: हा राम सत्यव्रत दीर्घबाहो हा पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमानवक्त्र। हा जीवलोकस्य हितः प्रियश्च वध्यां न मां वेत्सि हि राक्षसानाम्॥
en: O Rāma, O you of truthful vows, O you of long arms, O you having the countenance of a full moon! O my life! engaged as you are in the welfare of the people, do you not perceive that I am about to be killed by the Rākşasas.

sa: दृष्टा कथंचिद् भवती न कालः परिदेवितुम्। इमं मूहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि॥
en: Now that I have succeeded in seeing you after no end of ado, this is no time for lamentation. O fair one, this very moment you shall witness the end of your woe.

sa: इत्युक्ते राघवायाथ मतिमानङ्गदोऽग्रतः। विभीषणपरीक्षार्थमुवाच वचनं हरिः॥
en: They speaking thus to Rāghava, the intelligent monkey Angada, spoke as follows for sounding the intention of Vibhīşaņa.

sa: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा वचनं प्राह साञ्जलिः॥ वृतः सर्वगुणैर्नित्यं चन्द्रमा रश्मिभिर्यथा। भगवन्कृतकृत्योऽहं यन्मे लोकगुरुः स्वयम्॥ प्रीतेन यदि दातव्यो वरो मे शृणु सुव्रत ।
en: Thereat the virtuous Vibhīşaņa spoke with joined hands, 'O reverend one, since the spiritual preceptor of all creatures himself (is pleased) with me, I (deem myself) as furnished with every perfection, even as the Moon is envisioned with rays. If you will bestow on me a boon with pleasure, then, O you of excellent vows, hear of the boon that I would have.

sa: दात्यूहकोयष्टिवकैर्नृत्यमानैश्च बहिणैः। रुतं परभृतानां च शुश्रुवे वननिझरे॥
en: And it had Dātyühas, and Koyașthivas, and peacocks dancing; and the strains of the coels were heard at the woodland rills.

sa: पताकाभिश्च चित्राभिः सुमनोभिश्च चित्रिताम्। उत्क्षिप्य शिबिकां तां तु विभीषणपुरोगमाः॥
en: And taking up this litter adorned with various charming paintings and flags and carrying fire woods, all the Räksasas headed by Vibhīşaņa proceeded towards the south.* *Cremation-place.

sa: जाम्बवांस्त्वथ संप्रेक्ष्य शास्त्रबुद्ध्या विचक्षणः। वाक्यं विज्ञापयामास गुणवद्दोषवर्जितम्॥
en: There upon the wise Jāmbavān, arriving at conclusions by virtue of his knowledge of Šāstras, began with words, void of defects.

sa: तयोः स भ्राजते शब्दस्तथा समरयत्तयोः। सुघोरयोनि:स्वनतोगगने मेघयोरिव॥
en: As they faught with might and main, the sounds that they sent resembled the deep rumbling of clouds in the sky.

sa: अथवा तौ नरव्याघ्रौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। मन्निमित्तमनार्येण समरेऽद्य निपातितौ॥
en: Or it may be that today for me those foremost of men, the brothers-Rama and Laksmana-have been slain in encounter by this inglorious one.

sa: अस्यां स्नात्वा महानद्यां पाप्मनो विप्रमोक्ष्यथ। अहमप्यद्य पुलिने शरदिन्दुसमप्रभे॥ पुष्पोपहारं शनकैः करिष्यामि कपर्दिनः।
en: Bathing in this stream you shall be cleansed from sins. I shall, also on the coast of this river, like the rays of the autumnal moon, reverentially worship with flowers Mahādeva, holding Pināka in his hands.

sa: कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम समाश्वसिहि सुव्रत। दृष्टा देवी न संदेहो न चान्येन हनूमता॥
en: Do you console yourself, O Räma, by whom Kausalyā has become the mother of a good son. O you, rigidly observing any religious vow or obligation, forsooth has Hanumān behold the worshipful dame and none else.

sa: अदेशकाले संप्राप्त इत्ययं यद्भिभीषणः। विवक्षा तत्र मेऽस्तीयं तां निबोध यथामति।५६॥
en: And what little I have thought of, I have something to say (regarding Jambaban's proposal) that Vibhīşaņa has arrived at such a bad place and in such an evil hour.

sa: शशक्षतजकल्पेन सुशीतेन सुगन्धिना। चन्दनेन परार्थेन स्वनुलिप्तौ स्वलंकृतौ॥ उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ। यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ॥
en: Smeared and adorned with cool, fragrant, and excellent sandal resembling the blood of hares; pressed by paragons; odorous with incense; resisting (in battle) Yaksas, and Pannagas, Gandharvas, gods and Dānavas.

sa: स यूपाक्षोऽश्रुपूर्णाक्षः पितृव्ये निहते रणे।। अवरुह्य रथात्क्षिप्रं क्षीणेषु खङ्गमाददे॥
en: Thereat Yüpākşa, seeing his uncle slain in battle, with his eyes filled with tears, finding his shafts exhausted, swiftly descended from his car and took a sword.

sa: जगदद्याभिषिक्तं त्वामनुपश्यतु राघव। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं मध्याह्ने दीप्ततेजसम्।।।।।
en: Let the world, O Raghava, behold you installed (today) liku to the powerful midday Sun burning in effulgence.

sa: देवनिष्ठानभूतं तद्विमानं पुष्पकं मृधे। भज्यमानं तथैवासीदक्षयं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥
en: In that conflict Pușpaka presided over by divine energy, incapable of being destroyed by virtue of Brahma power, being broken, resumed its former shape.

sa: लङ्कादुर्गं समासाद्य राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृताः। भविष्यथ दुराधर्षाः शत्रूणां शत्रुसूदनाः॥
en: And occupying the citadel of Lankā, backed by innumerable Rākṣasas, you will be invincible to foes and capable of destroying them.'

sa: अब्रवीच्च परिष्वज्य सौमित्रिं राघवस्तदा। दिष्ट्या त्वां वीर पश्यामि मरणात्पुनरागतम्।।४७
en: Having embraced Sumitra's son, Raghava then addressed him saying, “By good fortune it is that, O hero, I see you returned from (the mansion of ) Death.

sa: ततः कोपसमाविष्टाः सर्वे भीमपराक्रमाः। तद्रक्षो बोधयिष्यन्तश्चक्रुरन्ये पराक्रमम्॥
en: And overcome with choler, they endowed with dreadful prowess addressed themselves vigorously to awakening him; and others put forth their energy.

sa: गतिं खर इवाश्वस्य हंसस्येव च वायसः। नान्वेतुमुत्सहे वीर तव मार्गमरिंदम ॥
en: As an ass cannot follow the course of a horse and a crow cannot follow that of a gander, so I am unable, O hero, O slayer of foes, to follow your footsteps.

sa: तदद्य विपुलं वीर दुःखमिन्द्रजिता कृतम्। कर्मणा व्यपनेष्यामि तस्मादुचिष्ठ राघव।॥
en: But, O hero, today, O Raghava, by my acts will I remove this huge sorrow that has been heaped upon us by Indrajit. Therefore, rise you up.

sa: हतप्रवीरा व्यथिता राक्षसेन्द्रचमूस्तथा। जगामाभिमुखी सा तु कुम्भकर्णात्मजो यतः॥
en: Thereupon the force of the lord of the Rāks asas, having its foremost heroes slain, and aggrieved thereat, went to where Kumbhakarma's son was.

sa: एोहीत्यब्रवीद्रामो लक्ष्मणं परवीरहा। सस्वजे गाढमालिङ्गय बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: “Come!” said that slayer of hostile heroesRāma and with his eyes filled with tears, he deeply embraced Lakşmaņa.

sa: न वयं तत्कुलीनाश्च राज्यकाझी च राक्षसः। पण्डिता हि भविष्यन्ति तस्माद्ग्राह्यो विभीषणः॥
en: We are not his kinsmen and this Rākşasa has come here with a view to gain the kingdom. Even the Rākşasas are wise enough to ascertain the proper course-so we must take Vibhisana.

sa: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्व मे न च वक्ष्यामि मैथिलि। चारित्रसुखशीलत्वात्प्रविष्टासि मनो मम ॥
en: I never told you untruths heretofore; nor, O Mithila's daughter, will I tell them to you now. You by virtue of your character conducive to delight, have found an access into my heart.

sa: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रौ महाबलौ। त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साही लोकान् भस्मीकरिष्यतः॥
en: Filled with hope from my sight of you, those foremost of persons, those mighty princes, shall reduce the worlds to ashes.

sa: अप्येव दहनं स्पृष्ट्वा वने तिष्ठन्ति पादपाः। राजदण्डपरामृष्टास्तिष्ठन्ते नापराधिनः॥
en: Even trees may exist in the forest, coming in contact with burning fire; but transgressors cannot exist, visited with the chastisement of the monarch.

sa: कामगं स्यन्दनं दिव्यमन्तरिक्षचरं ध्रुवम्। मायां च तामसी नाम यया संपद्यते तमः॥
en: He has also obtained illusory powers, which create darkness or ignorance, namely of ranging in the sky, of being eternal, of ascending a celestial car which curses at will and of creating darkness.

sa: अवलीनः स निर्वाक्यो हनुमाशिशपादुमे। सीतां संतर्जयन्तीस्ता राक्षसीरशृणोत् कपिः॥
en: Hanumān remained all along speechless and hidden on the ſinsapā tree. And that monkey heard all those demons remonstrate with Sītā in this way.

sa: तदिच्छामि त्वयाज्ञप्तं देवि किं करवाण्यहम्। रामलक्ष्मणयोः पार्श्व नयामि त्वां किमुत्तरम्॥
en: I desire to know, O worshipful dame, what behest of yours may I obey now. Shall I carry you to Rāma and Lakşmaņa on the northern shore of the Ocean?”

sa: ततो दृष्ट्वा सरुधिरं निषण्णं गाढमर्पितम्। भ्रातरं दीनवदनं पर्यदेवयदातुरः॥
en: Then, seeing his brother having a distressful countenance, covered with blood, feeble, and fast bound by the shafts, Rāma, greatly aggrieved, began to mourn.

sa: ततः पुत्रकृतस्नेहात्कम्प्यमानो महाधृतिः। माहिष्मतीपतिं द्रष्टुमाजगाम महानृषिः॥ ।
en: Having seen moved by the love for his son, the highly effulgent, great ascetic, proceeded to see the king of Māhismati.

sa: ईदृशैस्त्वं समाचारैर्यशोर्थकुलनाशनैः। धर्षणं प्राणिनां ज्ञात्वा स्वमतेन विचेष्टसे॥
en: You do (still) follow your own whims, knowing that people are injured by these actions which destroy piety, wealth and fame.

sa: परिधूनं विवर्णं च पतमानं तमब्रवीत्। मोघमस्त्रं न शक्यं तु ब्राह्मं कर्तुं तदुच्यताम्॥
en: And he spoke to him, greatly famished, of a pale countenance and lying on the earth, It is impossible to render this Brahma weapon fruitless. Therefore, do you speak (as to what is to be done).

sa: ततस्तु सुग्रीववचो निशम्य तद्धरीश्वरेणाभिहितं नरेश्वरः। विभीषणेनाशु जगाम संगमं पतत्त्रिराजेन यथा पुरन्दरः॥
en: Hearing the words of Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, the king of men (Rāma) made instantly friends with Vibhīşaņa, like to the conqueror of enemies' cities making friends with the king of birds.

sa: श्रुत्वैतद्वानरेन्द्रस्य सुषेणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। देवासुरं महायुद्धमनुभूतं पुरातनम् ॥
en: Hearing the words of the monkey-king, Suşeņa said, I had witnessed the war of yore between the gods and the Asuras.

sa: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना। प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं हर्षगद्गदया गिरा॥
en: Thereat, the Ten-necked one, bowing down his head to the deity, said with a delighted heart, his words faltering with ecstasy.

sa: यस्यार्थास्तस्य मित्राणि यस्यास्तस्य बान्धवाः। यस्यार्थाः स पुमाल्लोके यस्यार्थाः स च पण्डितः।।३५
en: To him that has wealth are friends, to him that has wealth are acquaintances, he that has wealth is an individuality in this world, and he that has wealth is a learned person.

sa: नदी बाहुसहस्रेण रुन्धन्तमरिमर्दनम्। गिरिं पादसहस्रेण रुन्धन्तमिव मेदिनीम्॥
en: Like to Sumeru holding the earth with his thousand feet he obstructed the current of the river with his thousand arms.

sa: अवप्लुत्य महावेगः प्रहस्तस्य निवेशनम्। ततोऽन्यत् पुप्लुवे वेश्म महापार्श्वस्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then that one endowed with wondrous motion, with a bound entered Prahasta's palace; and then with another, that (monkey) possessed of energy entered the into of Mahaparcwa.

sa: स प्रविश्य विचित्रां तां विहगैरभिनादिताम्। राजतैः काञ्चनैश्चैव पादपैः सर्वतो वृताम्॥ विहगै{गसङ्घश्च विचित्रां चित्रकाननाम्। उदितादित्यसंकाशां ददर्श हनुमान् बली॥ वृतां नानाविधैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पोपगफलोपगैः। कोकिलै ङ्गराजैश्च मत्तैर्नित्यनिषेविताम्।७।। प्रहृष्टमनुजां काले मृगपक्षिमदाकुलाम्। मत्तबर्हिणसंघुष्टां नानाद्विजगणायुताम्॥
en: Entering into the grove, variegated all over; resonant with the notes of birds, filled on all sides with golden and silver trees; many-hued with birds and beasts, containing dainty tracts of trees like to the risen Sun, the powerful Hanumān saw the place surrounded with various kinds of trees, having fruits and flowers; frequented by maddened coels and Bhramaras, with creatures expressing happiness by their movements, birds and beasts overflowing with spirits; echoing with the cries of peacocks; furnished with various species of fowls.

sa: प्रविष्टो नगरी लङ्कां लवयित्वा महोदधिम्। कृत्वा मूर्ध्नि पदन्यासं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः॥
en: I have entered this city of Lankā after crossing over the great main. And by means of my prowess and placing my feet on the head of the vicious-souled Ravana.

sa: ततश्चाख्यातुमारेभे विभीषणवचः शुभम्। सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवः सागरस्योपवेशनम् ॥
en: Thereupon, the broad-necked Sugrīva began to explain the well-meaning words of Vibhīşaņa, requesting Ráma to seek the shelter of the Ocean.

sa: ज्ञातींस्तान्धर्षयित्वेमास्त्वयानीता वराङ्गनाः। त्वामतिक्रम्य मधुना राजन्कुम्भीनसी हृता ॥
en: Having slain their kinsmen you past brought these beautiful damsels hither, but disregarding you, O King, Madhu has carried away Kumbhīnasī.

sa: स पश्चिमेन द्वारेण निर्ययौ राक्षसैर्वृतः। इन्द्रजित्सुमहावीर्य: पौलस्त्यो देवकण्टकः॥
en: That highly powerful, Indrajit, a descendant of Pulasta and an enemy of the celestials, issued out, encircled by the Rākşasas, by the western gate.

sa: सह संवृद्धभावेन संसर्गेण च मानद। यदि तेऽहं न विज्ञाता हता तेनास्मि शाश्वतम्॥
en: O you the conferrer of honour-our affection towards one another was increased by our living continually for a long time; even then if you have not been able to understand me I am ruined for ever.

sa: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता सुरसुतोपमा। उवाच वचनं मन्दं बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम्॥
en: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, Sītā resembling the daughter of a celestial, spoke, gently, words with their letters strung on the vapour of grief,

sa: स सागरमनाधृष्यमतिक्रम्य महाबलः। त्रिकूटस्य तटे लङ्कां स्थितः स्वस्थो ददर्श ह॥
en: Having crossed over the ocean incapable of being repressed, that one endowed with great strength, staying at the plateau of Chitrakūta, and having refreshed himself, cast his eyes on Laukā.

sa: न मां प्रार्थयितुं युक्तस्त्वं सिद्धिमिव पापकृत्। अकार्यं न मया कार्यमेकपत्न्या विगर्हितम्॥
en: Like to a sinner unworthy of praying for final emancipation, it dose not behove you to expect to come by me. Devoted to one husband I shall never perpetrate such an iniquitous act.

sa: नहीयं हरिभिर्लङ्का प्राप्तुं शक्या कथंचन। देवैरपि सगन्धर्वैः किं पुनर्नरवानरैः॥
en: The monkeys shall not by any means be able to attack the city of Lankā. Even the celestials and Gandharvas could not-what of these men and monkeys?

sa: क्रोधाद्द्विगुणताम्राक्षः पितुरतुल्यपराक्रमः। शिलां तां पातयामास धूम्राक्षस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: And with his eyes double reddened in wrath, the one, like to his sire himself in prowess, brought down the crag upon Dhūmrākṣa's car.

sa: प्रकाशनभ्रजालानि निष्क्रमंश्च पुनः पुनः। प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव दृश्यते॥
en: And now entering into clouds and now imerging from them, he, again and again becoming visible and lost to sight, looked like the Moon.

sa: काञ्चनाङ्गदसंनद्धो ददर्श स महात्मनः। विक्षिप्तौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भुजाविन्द्रध्वजोपमौ॥
en: Hanuman saw the arms of the huge-bodied lord of Raksasas, fastened with bracelets, stretched (there), like to the banners of Indra;

sa: ततो रामाभ्यनुज्ञातं तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। उत्तरां दिशमुद्दिश्य जगाम धनदालयम्॥
en: Thereupon being thus commanded by Rāma, that excellent car, proceeding towards the north, reached the abode of the Giver of wealth.

sa: एवमुक्तोऽथ वैदेह्या राघवः प्रत्युवाच ताम्। एवमस्त्विति किष्किन्धां प्राप्य संस्थाप्य राघवः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehi Rāghava replied-saying, "this shall be done" and getting at Kişkindhă he stopped the car. And having beheld the car stationed he spoke to Sugriva, saying.

sa: सीतासंदेशरहितं मामितस्त्वरया गतम्। निर्दहेदपि काकुत्स्थः क्रोधतीव्रण चक्षुषा ॥
en: And if I speedily repair hence without any information regarding Sītā, surely shall Kākuthutha scorci me lifeless with the fire of his angry eyes.

sa: ततः सागरवेलायां दर्भानास्तीर्य राघवः। अञ्जलिं प्राङ्मुखः कृत्वा प्रतिशिश्ये महोदधेः॥
en: Then on the shore of the sea, Rāghava, spreading darbha, with his hands joined towards the great deep, laid him down, with his face to the East.

sa: स ददर्श हतानन्दां सीतामिन्द्रजितो रथे। एकवेणिधरां दीनामुपवासकृशाननाम्॥
en: He beheld there, on Indrajit's car, Sita, deprived of all joy, poorly, greatly reduced with fasts and wearing a single braid.

sa: यथैव मां वनं यान्तमनुयातो महाद्युतिः। अहमप्यनुयास्यामि तथैवैनं यमक्षयम्॥
en: O you endowed with exceeding splendour, even as you did follow me into the forest, will I follow you to the mansion of Yama.

sa: संपीड्य च धनुर्घोरं कम्पयित्वा शनैर्जगत्। मुमोच विशिखानुग्रान्वजानिव शतक्रतुः॥
en: And straining his dreadful bow, making the earth shake, tremulously, he let fly fierce shafts like him of an hundred sacrifices hurling his thunder-bolt.

sa: विषयेषु प्रसक्तेन यत्किचित्कारिणा त्वया। ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानामुद्वेगो जनितो महान्॥
en: You, addicted to carnal pleasures and acting in defiance of duty, had aroused the high wrath of the saints resembling fire.

sa: तस्य नानद्यमानस्य सुपर्णाचरिते पथि॥ फलतीवास्य घोषेण गगनं सार्कमण्डलम्।
en: As he went on roaring in the path ranged by Suparna, the firmament with the solar disc seemed to be rent by his shouts.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा दधिमुखो वनपालान् महाबलः। जगाम सहसोत्पत्य वनपालैः समन्वितः॥
en: Having thus spoken to the guards of the forest the highly powerful Dadhimukha leaped high up in the welkin and went away with them.

sa: सेयमालोक्य मे रूपं जानकी भाषितं तथा। रक्षोभिस्त्रासिता पूर्वं भूयस्त्रासमुपैष्यति॥
en: And beholding my monkey shape and hearing my human language she might be afraid again, terrified as she had been before by the band of the Rākşasas.

sa: विसस कवेगेन पञ्च बाणशतानि यः। इष्वस्त्रेष्वधिकस्तस्मात्कार्तवीर्याच्च लक्ष्मणः॥
en: He that could discharge at one shot five hundred shafts, that Lakşmaņa is superior to karttaviryya himself in that weapon-the bow.

sa: स कथंचिद् विमुक्तस्तैर्वानरैर्वानरर्षभः। उवाचैकान्तमागत्य स्वान् भृत्यान् समुपागतान्॥
en: And thereupon releasing himself from them by some device that leading monkey, proceeded to a nook, and addressed his attendants, saying.

sa: अस्त्रैरसत्राणि यो हन्याच्छक्रस्यापि महात्मनः। सोऽयमुव्या हतः शेते महार्हशयनोचितः॥
en: He that with his arms could resist the arms of Sakra himself, that one worthy of a costly couchLeith down on the ground, slain.

sa: मदान्धो न कृपां चक्रे आर्यकोऽयं ममेति सः। अथैनं निष्पिपेषाशु वेगेन वसुधातले॥-
en: He was beside himself with intoxication and therefore did not show him the least mercy, albeit he (Dadhimukha) was worshipful to him. And accordingly with great vehemence he ground him to the dust.

sa: सवृक्षं तं महाबाहुमापतन्तं महाबलम्। वेगवन्तं विजग्राह बाहुभ्यां कुपितोऽङ्गदः॥
en: And as the mighty Dadhimukha of huge arms, was proceeding towards them vehemently with a huge tree, Angada, wroth, caught him by the hand.

sa: त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ। दिष्ट्या ते निहता राम महावीर्या निशाचराः॥
en: By good luck it is, O Rama, that these highly powerful night-rangers. Trisiras and Atikāya and Devāntaka and Narāntaka, have been slain by you.

sa: युध्यमानस्य रक्षोभिस्ततस्तैः क्रूरकर्मभिः। प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद् भयार्ता कपिसत्तम॥
en: When you shall be engaged in conflict with those Rākşasas of terrible deeds, I, O foremost of monkeys, stricken with fear, shall fall down from your back.

sa: बलान्निवारयन्तश्च आसेदुर्हरयो हरीन्। संदष्टौष्ठपुटाः कुद्धा भर्त्सयन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: And biting their lips in wrath and remonstrating with them again and again, those monkeys began to suppress them by force.

sa: स्निग्धस्य भजमानस्य युक्तमर्थाय कल्पितुम्। तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तथेत्याह मधुर्वचः॥
en: It behoves you to help him, who out of affection for me, has prayed for your help.” Hearing those words Madhu said:-"So be it."

sa: पितामहस्तु सुप्रीतः सार्धं देवैरुपस्थितः। तव तावद्दशग्रीव प्रीतोऽस्मीत्यभ्यभाषत॥
en: Well-pleased, the Pitamaha Brahmā came there along with the celestials. 'O Ten-necked one,' said (the Great-father), 'I am well-pleased with you.

sa: एवं स मन्त्रिवृद्धैश्च मात्रा च बहु बोधितः। न त्वामुत्सहते मोक्तुमर्थमर्थपरो यथा॥
en: Thus long exhorted by his counsellors as well as his mother, Rāvaņa does not make up his mind to emancipate you, even as a covetous person is loath to pare with wealth (appropriated).

sa: छिन्नेषु तेषु बाणौधैर्विचरन्तमभीतवत्। अर्दयामास समरे सौमित्रिः शीघ्रकृत्तमः॥
en: And on his steeds having been torn with shafts, Sumitrā's-foremost of fleet-handed in the encounter assailed (Indrajit) doubtlessly ranging the field.

sa: तस्य तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा शक्रो देवेश्वरस्तदा। रथस्थः समरस्थस्तान्देवान्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon being apprised of his intention, Śakra, the king of the celestials, stationed on car, said to the deities, in the field of battle.

sa: साधु धर्ममवेक्षस्व साधु साधुव्रतं चर। यथा तव तथान्येषां रक्ष्या दारा निशाचर॥
en: Have your eyes always on religion and do you follow in the track of piety. Like to yours own wives, others are worthy of being protected by you, O ranger of the night.

sa: ज्वलन्तं तेजसा नित्यं क्रोधेन च दुरासदम्। कस्तं मृत्युमिवासह्यमासादयितुमर्हति॥
en: But whom does it behove to confront him ever flaming in energy, difficult of being approached when enraged, and unbearable even like Death himself?

sa: अभिनिष्क्रम्य तद्द्वारं बलाध्यक्षमुवाच ह। त्वरयस्व बलं शीघ्रं किं चिरेण युयुत्सतः॥
en: And speedily sallying forth from the gate of (Ravana's residence, he said to the general of the forces, “Do you speedily move off your forces. why should a warrior linger?”

sa: ततः कुर्युः समाह्वानं राक्षस्यो रक्षसामपि। राक्षसेन्द्रनियुक्तानां राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशने॥
en: Then they shall call (to their assistance) all those Rākşasīs engaged in guarding the abode of the lord of the Rāksasas.

sa: नमः पूर्वाय गिरये पश्चिमायाद्रये नमः। ज्योतिर्गणानां पतये दिनाधिपतये नमः॥
en: Salutation to the Eastern mount and the mount of the West. Salutation to the lord of the stellar bodies and salutation also to the lord of day.

sa: ततः प्रवृत्तं सुमहत्तद्युद्धं लोमहर्षणम्। निशाचरैः प्लवंगानां देवानां दानवैरिव ॥
en: Thereupon ensued a terrible conflict, capable of making one's down stand on end, between the right-rangers and the monkeys like to one between the celestials and Dänavas.

sa: तावन्योन्यं जिघृक्षन्तौ हरिराक्षसपार्थिवौ। प्रयत्नवन्तौ तत्कर्म ईहतुर्बलदर्पितौ॥
en: Thereupon the king of monkeys and the lord of Rākşasas, proud of strength, essayed to catch one another.

sa: अथोवाच महातेजा हरिराजो महाबलः। किमियं व्यथिता सेना मूढवातेव नौर्जले॥
en: Then out spoke the highly energetic and exceedingly mighty king of monkeys, “Why is this host agitated like a bark driven hither and thither by the wind?"

sa: इति संचिन्त्य हनुमांस्तदा प्लवगसत्तमः। दर्शयामास सीतायाः स्वरूपमरिमर्दनः॥
en: Thinking thus, Hanumān, the foremost of the monkeys and the slayer of foes, showed himself to Sītā, in his true shape.

sa: कृतानि प्रथमेनाह्रा योजनानि चतुर्दश। प्रहृष्टैर्गजसंकाशैस्त्वरमाणैः प्लवङ्गमैः॥
en: And on the first day the elephant-like monkeys full of spirits and exerting themselves vigorously, finished fourteen Yojanas.

sa: क्ष्वेडन्तश्च प्लवन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवंगमाः। लब्धलक्षा रघुसुतं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे॥
en: And shouting and bounding and roaring, the monkeys at this hour of high joy stood surrounding Raghu's son.* *Descendant, that is.

sa: पुष्पकादवरुह्याथ रावणोऽञ्जनसंनिभः। ग्रहीतुं वालिनं तूर्णं निःशब्दपदमव्रजत्॥
en: Thereupon having descended from his Puşpaka car he with silent approached Vāli to bring him under his grasp.

sa: अथैनमनुसंक्रम्य हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। मम पृष्ठं समारुह्य राक्षसं शास्तुमर्हसि ॥ विष्णुर्यथा गरुत्मन्तमारुह्यामरवैरिणम्।
en: Thereat drawing near to him, Hanuman said to him, "It behove you to chastise the foe ascending my back, even as Vişņu chastise the enemies of the immortals, riding Garutmān."

sa: तस्य राक्षससैन्यस्य समन्तादुपयास्यतः। देवलोके बभौ शब्दो भिद्यमानार्णवोपमः॥
en: There arose in the region of celestials an uproar from the Rākṣasa army, like to the sound of the agitated deep.

sa: यथैवाहमिह प्राप्तस्तथैवाहमसंशयम्। यास्यामि पश्य वैदेहि त्वामुद्यम्य विहायसम्॥
en: In the same way I have come here I shall return by the welkin, O Vaidehī placing three on my back.

sa: स मण्डलीकृतधनू रावणिः समितिंजयः॥ हरीनभ्यहनत्क्रुद्धः परं लाघवमास्थितः।
en: That victor in battle— Rāvana's son fired with wrath, summoning all his celerity, slaughtered monkeys, drawing his bow into a circle.

sa: विभिन्नशिरसो भूत्वा राक्षसा रुधिरोक्षिताः। दुमैः प्रमथिताश्चान्ये निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Thereat some Rākşasas with their heads shattered, lay drenched in blood; and others, struck with trees, dropped down to the earth.

sa: राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु मकराक्षो महाबलः। बाणौधानमुचत्तस्मै राघवाय रणाजिरे॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāghava, the mighty Makarākşa, began to dart sharp arrows towards him in the battle-field.

sa: राघवे चार्थनिर्वृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः। समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः कर्मसिद्धिभिरुन्नताः॥ प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्विनः॥
en: They were resolved upon satisfying Rāma's end and acquiring glory for themselves. Their desires were satisfied and mind elevated in consequence of their beholding Sitã and burning down Lankā. All of them were anxious to communicate this pleasant news. to enter into conflict and were resolved upon bringing about Rāma's wellbeing.

sa: केचिदुच्छ्रितलाङ्गुलाः प्रहृष्टाः कपिकुञ्जराः॥ आयताञ्चितदीर्घाणि लाशूलानि प्रविव्यधुः।
en: And some elephantine monkeys in joy upraised their tails, and some lashed with their long and broad tails.

sa: यदीन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान्वा स्वयंभुवैश्वानरशंकरान्वा। गमिष्यसि त्वं दशधा दिशो वा तथापि ने नाद्य गतो विमोक्ष्यसे ॥
en: Even if you should seek Yama or Indra or the Sun-son to Vivaśvăn-or the Self-sprung or the Fire-god or Sankara himself, or go to the ten cardinal points in ten portions, yet shall you not, so resorting attain deliverance.

sa: तथा तयोविहरतोः सीताराघवयोश्चिरम्॥ अत्यक्रामच्छुभः कालः शैशिरो भोगदः सदा। प्राप्तयोविविधान्भोगानतीतः शिशिरागमः॥
en: Sītā and Rāghava thus spent their days happily. And thus was spent the delightful winter giving all enjoyments. Enjoying various things the high-souled Rāma and Sītā spent ten thousand years.

sa: अथायान्तं हनूमन्तं ददर्शक्षपतिस्तदा। वानरैः कृतसंग्रामैः श्वसद्भिरभिसंवृतम्॥
en: Then the lord of bears saw Hanumān approach, surrounded by monkeys sighing hard, who had faught the fight.

sa: लग्नमुत्कर्षतः खङ्ग खङ्गेन कपिकुञ्जरः। जहार स शिरस्त्राणं कुण्डलोपगतं शिरः॥
en: And as he was about to extricate his dagger from the armour, that foremost of monkeys severed with his dagger that Rākşasa's head with helmet and kundalas.

sa: यद्धामृतरसः पीतस्त्वया रावण राक्षस। तदा बालिनमासाद्य तदन्तं तव जीवितम्॥
en: O Ravana, O Raksasa, ever if you have drunk nectar, you shall at this very moment loose your life, when the encounter with Vāli shall take place.

sa: अहं सम्पातिवचनाच्छतयोजनमायतम्॥ तस्याहेतोविशालाक्ष्याः समुद्रं वेगवान् प्लुतः।
en: And by Sampāti's counsel and for that largeeyed dame, I have leapt a hundred leagues across the deep.

sa: सत्य मार्ग समारुद्भय विन्ध्योऽर्कस्येव पर्वतः। थितो विन्ध्य दवाक प्रहस्तो मुसलायुधः॥
en: Thereupon stood there obstructing his course Raksasa, worked up with anger and with a mace in his hand, like to the Vindhya range standing in the way of the sun.

sa: अथान्तरिक्षे व्यनदत्सौम्यस्त्रिदशदुन्दुभिः। दिव्यगन्धवहस्तत्र मारुतः सुसुखो ववौ॥
en: The celestial bugle was sounded in the sky and there blew the excellent air carrying the celestial fragrance.

sa: अत्र सा मृगशावाक्षी रावणेनोपरुध्यते। अभिभूता ग्रहेणेव लोहिताङ्गेन रोहिणी॥
en: Here that one having eyes resembling those of a young deer, is confined by Rāvana, like to Rohini overpowered by the red-bodied planet.* *Angāraka.

sa: किमर्थं मामवज्ञाय मच्छन्दमनवेक्ष्य च। त्वया शत्रुसमक्षं मे रथोऽयमपवाहितः॥
en: Wherefore disregarding me, and not minding O you of my purpose, have you taken away my car from before the presence of the enemy?

sa: नयनं चास्फुरद्वामं वामो बाहुरकम्पत। विवर्णवदनश्चासीत्किचिदभ्रश्यत स्वनः॥
en: His left eye and the left arm began to shakehis countenance became pale and his voice grew harsher.

sa: अन्या कक्षगतेनैव मड्डुकेनासितेक्षणा। प्रसुप्ता भामिनी भाति बालपुत्रेव वत्सला॥
en: And another dark-eyed which was asleep with her mudduka* on her lap, like a loving mother having a boy. *A kind of musical instrument.

sa: सदेवासुरयक्षेषु गन्धर्वोरगपक्षिषु। मैन्दस्य प्रतियोद्धारं शंसत द्विविदस्य वा॥
en: What hero is there among the celestials, Asuras, Yaksas, Gandharvas, serpents and birds who can equal Manida or Dvivida in battle?

sa: नाहत्वा समरे शत्रु विष्णुः प्रतिनिवर्तते। दुर्लभश्चैव कामोऽद्य वरगुप्तादि रावणात्॥
en: Without slaying the enemies in the encounter, Vişņu does never go black, but it is hard to fulfil my desire from Rāvaņa, well protected by the boon.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथावृत्तमनिन्दिते॥ अभिभाषस्व मां देवि दूतो दाशरथेरहम्।
en: O you of a blameless person, I have related all to you in regular order. Do you speak to me, O worshipful dame, I am Dasarathi's messenger.

sa: क्व च यक्षार्जवं युद्धं क्व च मायाबलाश्रयम्। रक्षसां पुरुषव्याघ्र तेन तेऽभ्यधिका युधि॥
en: Where is the candid-coursing fight of the Yakşas and where the fight of the Rākşas by help of the power of illusion; and therefore in that battle the advantage was on the side of the Raksasas.

sa: स शरो रावणं हत्वा रुधिरार्द्रकृतच्छविः। कृतकर्मा निभृतवत्स तूणीं पुनराविशत्॥
en: That shaft, slaying Răvaņa soaked in blood and successful, again entered the quiver* humbly. *In some texts there is "na punaravisat" i.e. did not enter the quiver.

sa: क्षीबो विचित्राभरणः शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः। तेन विश्रवसः पुत्रः स दृष्टो राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: There was a warder by name Sankukarņa in that forest—highly powerful, wearing various ornaments and addicted to drinking. And by him was seen that lord of Rākşasas—the son of Visrava.

sa: एवमेषा महाभागा मत्र्येषूत्पत्स्यते पुनः। क्षेत्रे हलमुखोत्कृष्टे वेद्यामग्निशिखोपमा॥
en: This one of eminent righteousness would again spring up on earth like a flame from a field furrowed by the plough.

sa: पूर्वं क्रोधहतः शत्रुर्ययासौ निहतस्तया। उपाश्रयित्वा शैलाभस्तव वीर्यममानुषम्॥
en: The enemy, endowed with the splendour of a hill, formerly that been slain by her, by help of your superhuman prowess.

sa: सा वीक्षमाणा पृथुभग्नवक्त्रं शाखामृगेन्द्रस्य यथोक्तकारम्। ददर्श पिङ्गप्रवरं महाहँ वातात्मजं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम्॥
en: And she again looked towards that Windgod's son, the foremost of the monkeys, the best of those gifted with intelligence, having a huge disfigured countenance, highly accomplished and wearing a dress mentioned before.

sa: ये च स्त्रीघातिनां लोका लोकवध्यैश्च कुत्सिताः। इह जीवितमुत्सृज्य प्रेत्य तान्प्रति लप्स्यसे॥
en: You shall after the death reach the place which is occupied by those who murder women, a place which is avoided even by those who commit every sort of crime punishable by law.

sa: ते भीमवेगा हरयो नर्दमानास्ततस्ततः। ममन्थुराक्षसान्वीरान्नामानि च बभाषिरे॥
en: Those monkeys, endowed with terrific vehemence, sending up shouts, and proclaiming their respective names, set about tossing the brave Rākşasa rank,

sa: स पितृव्यस्य संक्रुद्ध इन्द्रजिच्छरमाददे। उत्तमं रक्षसां मध्ये यमदत्तं महाबलम्॥
en: Thereat wroth with his uncle, Indrajit took up an excellent shaft-bestowed on him by Yama himself-endowed with terrific force, the flower of shafts among all the Rākşasas.

sa: शतं पद्मसहस्राणां महापद्ममिति स्मृतम्। महापद्मसहस्राणां शतं खर्वमिहोच्यते॥
en: An hundred of a thousand Padma is known as a Mahāpadma. An hundred of a thousand Mahāpadma is termed a Kharva.

sa: सुपर्णपृष्टे स बभौ श्यामः पीताम्बरो हरिः। काञ्चनस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे सतडित्तोयदो यथा॥
en: Seated on Suparma's* back, the blue-brown Hari clad in yellow attire resembled a mass of clouds on the crest of the golden mountain, with lightning playing through it. *Lit. fair-feathered-a name of Garua.

sa: स एष निर्गतो वीरः शिविराद्भीमविक्रमः। वानरान्भृशसंक्रुद्धो भक्षयन्परिधावति॥
en: That hero possessed of dreadful prowess, wrought up with high wrath, sallying forth from his camp, rush about, eating up monkeys.

sa: तद्यथा नमुचित्रोबलिर्नरकशम्बरौ। त्वदलं समवष्टभ्य मया दग्धास्तथा कुरु॥
en: As resorting to your prowess I destroyed Namuci, Vrtra, Bali, Naraka and Sambara, so do you make arrangements (for his destruction).

sa: सततं विविधैर्बाणैर्बभूव गगनं तदा। घनैरिवातपापाये विद्युन्मालासमाकुलैः॥
en: The sky was filled with their various weapons like to clouds in the rainy season accompanied with lightning.

sa: ततस्ते राक्षसाः शूरा बद्धं मामग्निसंवृतम्। अघोषयन् राजमार्गे नगरद्वारमागताः॥
en: Thereupon fettering me and putting fire to my tail and announcing me in the public streets those heroic Rākșasas got at the city gate.

sa: क्रोधं भीममहं मोक्ष्ये ससैन्ये त्वयि रावण। श्वः काल्ये वज्रवान्वजं दानवेष्विव वासवः॥
en: As Väsava equipped with the thunder-bolt hurled the same amidst the Dänavas, will I, O Rāvana, on the morning of the morrow pour down my dreadful ire upon you along with your forces.

sa: अङ्गदस्य चमू भीमा क्षोभयामास मार्गणैः। स वानराणां मुख्यानामुत्तमाङ्गानि राक्षसः॥ पातयामास कायेभ्यः फलं वृन्तादिवानिलः।
en: The Rākşasa, with his weapons assailed the dreadful army of Angada as well as the leading monkeys. The Rākşasa severed the heads from the bodies of the monkeys like to the wind throwing away the fruits from trees. were

sa: छन्दतः पृथिवीं चेरुर्बाधमानाः समन्ततः। श्रुत्वा नगानां चरितं महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः॥ वज्रेण भगवान्पक्षौ चिच्छेदैषां सहस्रशः। अहं तु मोचितस्तस्मात्तव पिता महात्मना ॥ मारुतेन तदा वत्स प्रक्षिप्तो वरुणालये। राघवस्य मया साह्ये वर्तितव्यमरिंदम॥ रामो धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः।
en: And (once on a time) they began to range the earth at will, committing devastations. Hearing of the conduct of the mountains, that possessor of the six kinds of riches, Indra the Great, the swayer of Pāka, with his thunderbolt cut off by thousands the pinions of the mountains. At that time, my son, I, having been delivered by your sire, high-souled Wind-god, was cast into the abode of Varuna. O repressor of foes, I shall have to assist Rāghava. Rāma is the foremost of the righteous, and possessed of prowess like that of Mahendra himself.

sa: संश्रुतं गृह्णता पाणिं चरिष्यामिति यत्त्वया। स्मर तन्नाम काकुत्स्थ नय मामपि दुःखिताम्॥
en: That you at the time of your espousing my hand had vowed, I will practise (righteousness) with you, do you, O Kakutstha, recollect the same, and take me, who am overwhelmed with distrees.

sa: यदि मामभियुञ्जीरन्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः। नैव सीतामहं दद्यां सर्वलोकभयादपि ॥
en: Even if the gods, Gandharvas and Dänavas should attack me, Sītā will I not part with from fear of all creatures.

sa: गृहीतमूर्धजां दृष्ट्वा हनूमान्दैन्यमागतः। दुःखजं वारि नेत्राभ्यामुत्सृजन्मारुतात्मजः॥
en: Seeing her thus caught by the head, Hanumān, the son of Maruta, greatly sorry, began to shed tears.

sa: प्रचक्रू राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पितृमेधमनुत्तमम्। वेदिं च दक्षिणा प्राची यथास्थानं च पावकम्॥ पृषदाज्येन संपूर्ण स्रुवं स्कन्धे प्रचिक्षिपुः। पादयोः शकटं प्रापुरूर्वोचोलू खलं तदा॥
en: And raising an altar at the south-east corner they placed fire at the proper place. They then poured curd and clarified butter upon Rāvana's) shoulders. And placing Sakata on his legs, Ulukhala* on his things, and the brass utensils, Arunis and Musals in their proper places, they celebrated (the obsequies of his manes). *A wooden mortar used for cleaning rice.

sa: वधायेन्द्रिजितो राम संदिशस्व महाबलम्। हते तस्मिन्हतं विद्धि रावणं ससुहृद्गणम्॥
en: O Rāma, for compassing the destruction of Indrajit, do you commission a mighty force. On his being slain, know that Rāvana along with his retainers are slain.

sa: ग्रहणे चापि रक्षोभिर्महन्मे गणदर्शनम्। राक्षसेन्द्रेण संवादस्तस्माद् गृह्णन्तु मां परे॥
en: It will be better if I am carried off by the Rākşasas, for I shall reap very great benefit by my conversation with the lord of Rākşasas.

sa: तेषां पुरस्ताद्वलवान्गच्छतां गहने वने। विनदन्सुमहानादं विराधः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: Your entering the dense forest there appeared before them the powerful Virādha* emitting a dreadful sound. *A demon of that name.

sa: सोऽभिवाद्य गुरोः पादौ कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। निकुम्भिलामभिययौ चैत्यं रावणिपालितम्॥
en: Having saluted at the feet of his superior and went round him, Lakşmaņa set out for the sacrificial ground (named) Nikumbhila, protected by the son of Rāvana.

sa: इमौ तौ सत्त्वसंपन्नौ विक्रान्तौ प्रियसंयुगौ। इमामवस्थां गमितौ राक्षसैः कूटयोधिभिः॥
en: The Rāksasas, fighting in wily ways, have brought to this pass these ones endowed with prowess and possessed of every perfection and gifted with might (of arm).

sa: स तस्य वीरस्य महारथस्य धनुष्मत: संयति सम्मतस्य। श्वचार मार्गे पितुरप्रमेयः॥
en: And baffling the shafts of that hero of a mighty car, an accomplished bowman and a finished warrior, the immeasurably powerful monkey increasing himself began to range in the welkin.

sa: तमुत्क्षिप्य महानादमूर्ध्वबाहुमधोमुखम्। निखाते प्रक्षिपन्ति स्म नदन्तमिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Taking him up roaring aloud like an elephant Rāma threw him with his arms upwards and face downwards into a pit.

sa: सुमालिनं समासाद्य राक्षसं रघुसत्तम। स्थिताः प्रख्यातवीर्यास्ते वंशे सालकटङ्कटे॥
en: O best of the Raghus, these Rākşasa of celebrated prowess, related to the race of Sälakatankața, remained under the leadership of the Rākṣasa Sumāli.

sa: पक्षवातबलोद्भूतो माल्यवानपि राक्षसः। स्वबलेन समागम्य ययौ लङ्कां ह्रिया वृतः॥
en: And pushed off by the violence of the wind of (Garuda's) wings, the Rākṣasa Mālyavān also, joined by his own forces, departed for Lankā, covered with shame.

sa: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि भ्रातृतुल्योऽधिकोऽपि वा। भविष्याम्योजसा चैव संतापं त्यज हृद्गतम्॥
en: I truly promise to you that I will be equal to my brother (in energy), or excel him in it. Therefore do you cast off this sorrow in your heart.

sa: इन्द्रजिच्चापमादाय शितशल्यांश्च सायकान्। हनूमन्तमभिप्रेत्य जगाम रणपण्डितः॥
en: And taking up a bow and sharpened darts, Indrajit, versed in the rules of war, proceeded towards Hanumān.

sa: ततः प्रयातः सहसा राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः। रावणः सत्त्वगाम्भीर्याद्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम्॥
en: Thereupon proceeded Råvana, encircled by many a Raksasa as if rending the earth with the excess of his prowess. arose was

sa: कदाचिदटमानोऽसावतिधर्ममुपागतः। अर्चितस्तु यथान्यायं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥ सुखासीनः कथामेनां मया पृष्टः स कौतुकात्।
en: Once on a time while travelling that highly pious ascetic arrived at my hermitage; I duly worshipped and welcomed him; and when I asked him out of curiosity, he, seated at pleasure, said.

sa: संजय उवाच मायां न सेवे भद्रं ते न वृथा धर्ममाचरे। शुद्धभाव गतो भक्त्या शास्त्राद् वेद्मि जनार्दनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said I do not care much for illusion (worldly matters); nor do I practice useless things (religious ceremonies in form without faith in the Supreme Being). Good betide you! With the aid of faith derived from purity of mind, do I know Janardana from the holy books.

sa: सत्यं ध्यानं समाधानं चोद्यं वैराग्यमेव च। अस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यं च तथा संचहमेव च।॥
en: These are truth meditation, a conception of the distinctness of subject and object, capability of arriving at conclusions, renouncement of the world, the habit of never taking what belongs to another, asceticism and non-acceptance of gifts.

sa: आर्यजुष्टमिदं वृत्तमिति विज्ञाय शाश्वतम्। सन्तः परार्थं कुर्वाणा नावेक्षन्ति परस्परम्॥
en: Knowing that this is the eternal custom of the good and the virtuous, pious people devote themselves to acts of self-sacrifice for others without expecting any return.

sa: तत्रापश्यन्महाभाग शालवृक्षमुपाश्रितम्। कौश्यां बृस्यां समासीनं चक्षुर्हीनं नृपं तदा॥
en: And there (in the hermitage) he saw that highly wise and old king seated on a mat of Kusha grass under a Sala tree.

sa: पतिष्यंश्चिन्तयामास गतिं गतिमतां वरः। एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु नैमिषे पार्थिवर्षभान्॥
en: While falling that foremost of those who had attained salvation thought of the course of his fall (and the place he should fall on in the end.)

sa: संरब्धं रक्तनेपथ्यं गोपालानां पुरोगमम्। विराटमभिनन्दन्तमथ मे भवति ज्वरः॥
en: Beholding that hero clad in red garments, busy in gratifying Virata and posing himself at the head of the cowherds, fever comes on me.

sa: ततस्तु श्वश्रूश्वशुरावूचतुस्तां नृपात्मजाम्। एकान्तमास्थितां वाक्यं प्रीत्या भरतसत्तम॥
en: Then, O best of the Bharatas, her father-in-law and mother-in-law gladly told the king's daughter who was seated alone, these words.

sa: अन्तकः पवनो मृत्युस्तथाग्निर्वडवामुखः। कुर्युरेते क्वचिच्छेषं न तु क्रुद्धो धनंजयः॥
en: The regent of Dead, the god of air and the horse-faced god of fire, leave some thing behind but Dhananjaya, worked up with anger, never does so.

sa: निरीक्षमाणा भर्तारं स्रवावस्थमनिन्दिता। मृतमेव हि भर्तारं काले मुनिवचः स्मरन्॥
en: That blameless girl, however, began to watch all the movements of her husband; but remembering what the sage (Narada) had said, she considered him as already dead.

sa: द्वाराणि तस्येह वदन्ति सन्तो बहुप्रकाराणि दुराधराणि। सत्यार्जवे ह्रीर्दमशौचविद्या यथा न मोहप्रतिबोधनानि।।
en: Virtuous men speak of several doors in this world to heavenly prosperity, which are difficult of being properly watched. The doors are truthfulness, kindness, modesty, selfcontrol and knowledge which are antidotes of ignorance.

sa: यथामति ब्रवीम्येतद् विद्धि मामधिकं ततः। द्रष्टासि युधि सम्बाधे प्रवृत्ते वैशसेऽहनि॥
en: Know me to be possessed of greater strength than what I have described of my own will. On the day in which the fierce battle begins, you will see me.

sa: सुचेतसौ बलिनौ शीघ्रहस्तौ सुशिक्षितौ भ्रातरौ फाल्गुनेन। श्येनौ यथा पक्षिपूगान् रुजन्तौ माद्रीपुत्रौ शेषयेतां न शत्रून्॥
en: The two brothers, the sons of the king of Madri, of good heart, strong quick-handed and well trained by the sons of Falguna, will leave no vestige of the enemies as a pair of birds of prey destroy a flight of birds.

sa: जानासि हि यथैतेन द्रौपदी पापबुद्धिना। परिक्लिष्टा सभामध्ये तच्च तस्योपमर्षितम्॥
en: You know, how by that evil-minded one Draupadi was troubled and annoyed in the midst of the Council and that act of his was borne with difficulty.

sa: सहोषितश्चरितार्थो वयस्थो मात्स्येयानामधिपो वै विराटः। स वै सपुत्रः पाण्डवार्थं च शश्वद् युधिष्ठिरं भक्त इति श्रुतं मे॥
en: Virata, the lord of the people of Matsya, who is of mature age, who has lived with the Pandavas and whose desires have been fulfilled by them, with his sons is there ever increased in the cause of the sons of Pandu and a staunch adherent of Yudhishthira.

sa: न हीदृशी मनुष्येषु सुलभा वरवर्णिनी। नारी सर्वानवद्याङ्गी देवीं मन्यामहे वयम्॥
en: Surely such a lady, of exceeding grace an perfectly faultless limbs, is hardly to be found among men. Indeed she seems in all wise to be a goddess to us.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तां नहुषश्चापि वयोरूपसमन्विताम्। समहष्यत दुष्टात्मा कामोपहतचेतनः॥
en: And Nahusha seeing her, possessed of youth and beauty, became pleased; the consciousness of that vicious soul was stricken with passion.

sa: स नाम सम्यग् वर्तेत पाण्डवेष्विति माधव। न मे संजायते बुद्धिर्बीजमुप्तमिवोषरे॥
en: That he should treat the Pandavas justly, O Madhava, dose not seem possible to me. Good counsel to him will give the same result as seed thrown on barren lands.

sa: एवं विनिश्चयं कृत्वा इन्द्राणी कार्यसिद्धये। अभ्यगच्छत सव्रीडा नहुषं घोरदर्शनम्॥
en: Making herself sure on this point, the queen of Indra went with bashful looks to Nahusha (now) fearful to look at, for the accomplishment of the object.

sa: क्षिप्रं त्वामभिकामश्च विनशिष्यति पापकृत्। नहुषो देवि शक्रश्च सुरेश्वर्यमवाप्स्यति॥
en: That doer of vicious deeds Nahusha, desirous of you, O goddess, will soon be destroyed and Shakra will regain the lordship of the gods.

sa: मोचयेयं मृत्युपाशात् संरब्धान् कुरुसुंजयान्। पाण्डवान् धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च सर्वां च पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: Then shall I free the band of the fated Kurus and Pandavas from the trap of death, as also this earth and all the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: सर्वं त्विदं ममायत्तं बीभत्सो कर्मणोर्द्वयोः। क्षेत्रं हि रसवच्छुद्धं कर्मणैवोपपादितम्॥
en: Everything about these two acts (peace and war) is within my power. Land is moistened and purified (i.e. all weeds are rooted out of it) by action.

sa: आवन्त्यौ च महीपालौ महाबलसुसंवृतौ॥ पृथगक्षौहिणीभ्यां तावभियातौ सुयोधनम्।
en: And so did the two kings of Avanti surrounded by large forces, each with an Akshauhini of troops came to Suyodhana.

sa: तथा भूरिश्रवाः शूरः शल्यश्च कुरुनन्दन॥ दुर्योधनमुपायातावक्षौहिण्या पृथक् पृथक्।
en: In the same way, Bhurishravas and the hero Shalya, O son of Kuru, went to Duryodhana, each with an army counting an Akshauhini separately.

sa: नाहमिच्छामि नहुषं पतिं देवर्षिसत्तम। शरणागतास्मि ते ब्रह्मस्त्रायस्व महतो भयात्॥
en: O you best among the Devarshis, I have no inclination for Nahusha; I have thrown myself under your protection, O Brahmanas, save me from this great calamity.

sa: इन्द्रादं विशिष्टो नहुषो देवराजो महाद्युतिः। वृणोत्विमं वरारोहा भर्तृत्वे वरवर्णिनी॥
en: The king of the gods Nahusha of great luster is superior to Indra. Let this lady with slender waist and bright complexion, choose him as her husband.

sa: यशोमानौ वर्धयन् पाण्डवानां पुराऽभिनच्छिशुपालं समीक्ष्य। यस्य सर्वे वर्धयन्ति स्म मानं करूषराजप्रमुखा नरेन्द्राः॥
en: In days of old did Krishna merely by looking at him (Shishupala) who was honoured by the kings, at whose head stood the king of the Karushas thereby increasing the fame and honour of the Pandavas.

sa: देवा ऊचुः इन्द्राणीमानयिष्यामो यथेच्छसि दिवस्पते। जहि क्रोधमिमं वीर प्रीतो भव सुरेश्वर॥
en: The gods said We shall bring here the wife of Indra as you wish, O lord of the heaven; O hero put aside this anger and be propitious, o lord of the gods.

sa: निवर्तय मनः पापात् परदाराभिमर्शनात्। देवराजोऽसि भद्रं ते प्रजा धर्मेण पालय॥
en: Turn back your mind from the wish of ravishing the wife of another. You are the king of the gods, we wish you well, protect your subjects by virtuous means.

sa: संजास्तस्य चात्मानं मम चैव परं मतम्। अजानन्निव मां कस्मादर्जुनद्याभिशङ्कसे॥
en: Knowing then his purposes and my dearly cherished intentions, why do you, O Arjuna, seem to be afraid of me, as if you did not know them.

sa: सद्यो वशं समापन्नः शत्रूणां शत्रुकर्शन। सेनाजीवैश्च कौरव्य तथा विषयवासिभिः॥
en: When you were defeated by the foe. O chastiser of foes, O descendant of Kuru, those that reside in the dominion of the king, specially the warriors.

sa: तस्य योऽसौ तदार्केण राक्षसः संनियोजितः। स कीचकमपोवाह वातवेगेन भारत॥
en: 0 Bharata, the Rakshasa that was appointed by the sun-god for her protection, gave a push to Kichaka with as much force as that of the wind.

sa: तस्मिँल्लोकपरित्यक्ते किं कार्यमवशिष्यते।। हते दुर्योधने राजन् यदन्यत् क्रियतामिति॥
en: When he is forsaken by men, what shall there be left to be done and Duryodhana is killed; do whatever remains to be accomplished.

sa: तस्मान्माद्रीसुतः शूरो यदाह रणकर्कशः। वचनं सर्वयोधानां तन्मतं पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Therefore what the heroic son of Madri terrific in battle has said is the opinion of all the soldiers, O you foremost of men.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच यदेतनर्तनागारं मत्स्यराजेन कारितम्। दिवात्र कन्या नृत्यन्ति रात्रौ यान्ति यथागृहम्॥
en: Draupadi said Behold there is the dancing hall erected by the king of the Matsya's. Here the girls dance during the day and retire to their respective homes at night.

sa: तानभ्ययुस्तदा वैश्याः शूद्राश्चैव पितामह। एकतस्तु त्रयो वर्णा एकतः क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥
en: They were joined. O grandfather, by the Vaishyas and Sudras. There were thus on one side three orders and those best among the Kshatriyas on the other.

sa: आख्यातारश्च विद्यन्ते पुमांश्चेद् विद्यते कुले। न चापि वैरं वैरेण केशव व्युपशाम्यति॥
en: There should be no story-teller (to remind him of his wrongs) so long as there is a man alive in the enemy's) family. Enmity, is never turned into peace by enmity, O Keshava.

sa: तां मृगीमिव संत्रस्तां दृष्ट्वा कृष्णां समीपगाम्। उदतिष्ठन्मुदा सूतो नावं लब्वेव पारगः॥
en: Beholding Krishna come to his presence like a terrified doe, the Suta rose up just like a person wishing to go to the other end of a river when he obtains a boat.

sa: अकीर्तिं सर्वभूतेषु शाश्वती सोऽधिगच्छति। न हि वैराणि शाम्यन्ति दीर्घकालधृतान्यपि॥
en: And he gets the reverse of fame from all beings throughout his life. Enmity though kept alive for a long time is never brought to an end.

sa: पृथगक्षौहिणीनां च प्रणेतृन् नरसत्तमान्। विधिवत् पूर्वमानीय पार्थिवानभ्यभाषत॥
en: Having those best among men the leaders of his Akshauhinis brought before them with suitable honour he spoke to them separately.

sa: एतत् समर्थं पार्थानां तव चैव यशस्करम्। क्रियमाणं भवेत् कृष्ण क्षत्रस्य च सुखावहम्॥
en: This would be just the thing for the son of Pritha to do; and will also redound to your glory; and the accomplishment will be, O Krishna, the source of happiness to the entire Kshatriya race.

sa: रथस्य नागाः पञ्चाशन्नागस्यासन् शतं हयाः। हयस्य पुरुषाः सप्त भिन्नसंधानकारिणः॥
en: There was also another reserve army in which for every chariot there were five elephants, for every elephant one hundred horses, and for every horse seven men.

sa: छिद्रान्वेषी समुद्विग्नः सदा वसति देवराट्। स कदाचित् समुद्रान्ते समपश्यन्महासुरम्॥
en: The chief among the gods always remained anxious land on the look out for some loop-hole. He one day saw the great Asura at the sea coast.

sa: न्मतिः कुरूणामागतः स्यादभावः। काव्यां वाचं विदुरो भाषमाणो न विन्दते यद् धार्तराष्ट्रात् प्रशंसाम्॥
en: At that time, O Sanjaya, when I was playing at dice did it occur to me that the destruction of the Kurus was come for Vidura speaking these wise words did not obtain praise from Dhritarashtra.

sa: तदर्थलुब्धस्य निबोध मेऽद्य ये मन्त्रिणो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सूत। दुःशासनः शकुनिः सूतपुत्रो गावल्गणे पश्य सम्मोहमस्य॥
en: Hear now from me who are the ministers of the son of Dhritarashtra for the promotion of his interest, O Suta. They are Dhritarashtra, Shakuni and the son of Suta (Karna). O son of Gavalgani, look at his folly.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वासुदेवोऽपि सव्यसाचिवचस्तदा। स्मयमानोऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं पार्थमेवमिति ब्रुवन्॥
en: Vasudeva too hearing those words of Savyasachin, said laughingly to the son of Pritha (Arjuna) “It is as you have said.”

sa: स्तनौ पीनायतश्रोणी सहिताबभिवर्षती। द्रवीभूतमिवात्युष्णं मुञ्चन्ती वारि नेत्रजम्॥
en: And the lady with beautiful hips began to shower from her eyes extremely hot tears, which flowed down her round bosom.

sa: पापः क्षत्रियधर्मोऽयं वयं च क्षत्रबन्धवः। स नः स्वधर्मोऽधर्मों वा वृत्तिरन्या विगर्हिता।॥
en: These practices of the Kshatriyas are sinful; but, alas, we are born in Kshatriya families and whether such practices are virtuous or the reverse; any other course of life would not be right!

sa: तदुत्सव इवोदचं सम्प्रहृष्टनरावृतम्। नगरं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य भारतासीत् समाकुलम्॥
en: Then did that army, of the son of Dhritarashtra made up of cheerful men, look like a festive city, O Bharata.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विराटराजं तरसा समेयिवान्। तमापतन्तं ददृशे पृथग्जनो विमुक्तमभ्रादिव सूर्यमण्डलम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then there was seen another mighty son of Pandu approaching king Virata in haste; the common people thereof saw him coming like solar orb freed from the clouds.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो व्यपेततमसि सूर्ये विमलवद्गते। मैत्रे मुहूर्ते सम्प्राप्ते मृदर्चिषि दिवाकरे॥
en: Vaishampayana said The night passed away and the sun having risen, as it were and on the setting in of the moment, called Maitri, while the rays of the sun were still mild.

sa: महायन्त्राणि नाराचास्तोमराणि परश्वधाः। धनूंषि कवचादीनि ऋष्टयस्तूणसंयुताः॥
en: Large machines, long shafts, to maras, and battle-axes, bows, coats of mail, breast-plates and quivers were also there.

sa: ऋषभाँश्चापि जानामि राजन् पूजितलक्षणान्। येषां मूत्रमुपाघ्राय अपि वन्ध्या प्रसूयते॥
en: O king, I also know the bulls having marks for which they are adored by people and by smelling whose urine even the barren may be fruitful.

sa: तस्माच्छकविनाशाय वृत्रमुत्पादयाम्यहम्। लोकाः पश्यन्तु मे वीर्यं तपसश्च बलं महत्॥
en: For this reason shall I create Vritra with a view to destroy Shakra. Let the worlds see my influence and power as also the great strength devotion.

sa: शार्दूलैर्महिषैः सिंहैरागारे योध्यसे यदा। कैकेय्याः प्रेक्षमाणायास्तदा मे कश्मलं भवेत्॥
en: When you fought with lions, tigers and buffaloes in the inner apartment of the palace in the occular presence of Kaikayi then the faint came over me.

sa: परिहत्य श्मशानानि देवतायतनानि च। आश्रमांश्र महर्षीणां तीर्थान्यायतनानि च।॥
en: Avoiding cremation grounds other sacred places and horses consecrated to the gods, and the hermitages of the great Rishis and also other holy places,

sa: न च तानपि दुष्टात्मा धार्तराष्ट्रोऽनुमन्यते। स्वाम्यमात्मनि मत्वाऽसावतो दुःखतरं नु किम्॥
en: Not this even dose the wicked-souled son of Dhritarashtra grant, thinking the proprietary rights of the entire earth to be vested in him. What is there more regrettable than this.

sa: अतिथिव्रती क्रियावांश्च कापोती वृत्तिमास्थितः। सत्रमिष्टीकृतं नाम समुपास्ते महातपाः॥ सपुत्रदारो हि मुनिः पक्षाहारो बभूव ह। कपोतवृत्त्या पक्षण व्रीहिद्रोणमुपार्जयत्॥
en: Although leading his life like a pigeon that great ascetic entertained his guests, celebrated the sacrefice called Ishtikhita and performed other rites. That Rishi, with his wife and son, ate for a fortnight and during the other fortnight he led the life of a pigeon collecting (but) a drona of corn.

sa: नदन्तं च महानादं भिन्नभेरीसमस्वनम्। भ्रामयामास सुचिरं विस्फुरन्तमचेतसम्॥
en: Then Bhima began to whirl him who was senseless, for a considerable time, and he roared terribly like a discordant bugle.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच मिच्छाम्यहं भूतिमेषां प्रियं च। तथा राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रस्य सूत समाशंसे बहुपुत्रस्य वृद्धिम्॥
en: Vasudeva said I desire, O Sanjaya, the continuance of the existence of the sons of Pandu-their prosperity and their good and in the same way, O Suta, do I desire the prosperity of king Dhritarashtra who has many sons.

sa: अभिगम्याथ तं विप्रमुवाच मुनिसत्तमः। अन्नार्थिनमनुप्राप्तं विद्धि मां द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Having arrived there, that foremost of Rishis spoke thus to that Brahimana, “O best of Brahmanas, know that I have come here for food.

sa: ऊढात् प्रभृति दुःखानि श्वसुराणामरिंदम। निकारानतदर्हा च पश्यन्ती दुःखमश्नुते॥
en: Ever since her wedding has she, O chastiser of foes, encountered troubles and grief's due to her father-in-law, though she has not deserved these.

sa: न नूनं म्रियते दुःखैः सा चेज्जीवति केशव। तथा पुत्रादिभिर्गाढमार्ता ह्यानर्तसत्कृत॥
en: One does not necessarily die of grief and if she is alive, O Keshava, hospitably entertained by the Anartas through in extreme distress on account of her sons and others.

sa: वज्रमस्य क्षिपाम्यद्य स क्षिप्रं न भविष्यति॥ शत्रुः प्रवृद्धो नोपेक्ष्यो दुर्बलोऽपि बलीयसा।
en: (Thought he) I shall this soon cease to exist. A foe who has already grown up must not be made light of by even the powerful, a weak foe though he might be.

sa: यदस्माकं विभो वृत्तं पुरा वै मन्त्रनिश्चये। अर्धराज्यस्य गोविन्द विदितं सर्वराजसु॥
en: O Lord, O Govinda, it is know among all the kings that it has already been decided in our consultation to demand the return of one half of the kingdom.

sa: वेपमानश्च कौन्तेयः प्राक्रोशन्महतो रवान्। धनंजयवचः श्रुत्वा हर्षोत्सिक्तमना भृशम्॥
en: And while trembling, the son of Kunti sent forth loud shouts hearing the words of Dhananjaya; and his mind was exceedingly filled with delight.

sa: यमो राजा वैश्रवणः कुवेरो गन्धर्वयक्षाप्सरसश्च सूत। ब्रह्मविद्या ब्रह्मचर्य क्रिया च निषेवमाणा ऋषयोऽमुत्र भान्ति॥
en: King Yama, the son of Vishravana, Karna, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas and the celestial nymphs, O Suta and the Rishis in the other world shine resplendent practicing the austerities of a Brahmacharya life and seeking the knowledge of self.

sa: नित्यं संदर्शयामासुस्तथैवाङ्गेषु सौष्ठवम्। नाभ्यगच्छत् प्रहर्षं ताः स पश्यन् सुमहातपाः॥
en: They displayed too the beauties of their person but the great devotee, though looking at them, did not at all enjoy the satisfaction (of looking at them).

sa: तेषु राजसु सर्वेषु निवृत्तेषु जनार्दनः। तूर्णमभ्यगमद्धृष्टः शैव्यसुग्रीववाहनः॥
en: And all these kings having returned Janardana made good progress in his journey, light of heart, drawn by Saivya and Sugriva.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ते तु कृष्णेन सम्प्राहृष्यन्नरोत्तमाः॥ तेषां प्रहृष्टमनसां नादः समभवन्महान्।
en: Vaishampayana said Krishna having said this all those best among men were highly rejoiced and there was a great shout sent up by these whose minds had been made cheerful.

sa: ईदृशः स मुने लोकः स्वकर्मफलहेतुकः। सुकृतैस्तत्र पुरुषाः सम्भवन्त्यात्मकर्मभिः॥
en: O Rishi, the world obtained as the fruit of one's (good) acts is like this. Men go there by virtue of their meritorious acts.

sa: मृगाः शकुन्ताश्च वदन्ति घोरं हस्त्यश्वमुख्येषु निशामुखेषु। वर्णान् बहून् पुष्यति घोररूपान्॥३९।
en: The birds and beasts are making loud sounds; and the best of elephants and horses assume terrible appearances at the approach of night. Fire too assumes many terrific looking colours.

sa: तेषामनुमतं ज्ञात्वा राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। सभावास्तूनि रम्याणि प्रदेष्टुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: King Duryodhana, then ascertaining that desire of theirs began to order the selection of sites for the erection of enchanting Pavilions.

sa: यथा स हतदर्पश्च हृततेजाश्च पाण्डव। भविष्यति सुखं हन्तु सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: (I shall do this) so that his energy will be killed and his pride gone, O son of Pandu and then it will be easy to kill him. I speak with all sincerity.

sa: संज्ञामोहश्च पततां रजसा च प्रधर्षणम्। प्रम्लानेषु च माल्येषु ततः पिपतिषोर्भयम्॥
en: The consciousness of those about to fall is stupified and it is also agitated by emotions. As the garlands of those about to fall fade away, fear possesses their hearts.

sa: कृषि वाचकः शब्दो च निर्वृतिवाचकः। विष्णुस्तद्भावयोगाच्च कृष्णो भवति सात्वतः॥
en: Krishi is a word denotes existence; and may denotes eternal tranquility. From the combination of these two states is Vishnu, born of the Satvata race, called Krishna.

sa: अजिनानां सहस्राणि चीनदेशोद्भवानि च। तान्यप्यस्मै प्रदास्यामि यावदर्हति केशवः॥
en: Thousands of deer skins produced in the country of China shall I give to him and whatever else may be fitting gifts to Keshava.

sa: कुशलं राजशार्दूलं कच्चित् ते कुरुनन्दन। अरण्यवासाद् दिष्ट्यासि विमुक्तो जयतां वर॥
en: O best among kings, O son of Kuru, is it all right with you? O you victorious one! you have now passed the prescribed period of residence in the forest.

sa: एतज्ज्ञानं विदुर्विप्रा ध्रुवमिन्द्रियधारणम्। एतज्ज्ञानं च पन्थाश्च येन यान्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: The control of the senses is known by Brahmanas to be certainly the true wisdom; and true wisdom is the path along which an intelligent man goes.

sa: एष एकायनः पन्था येन यान्ति मनीषिणः। तं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युमत्येति महांस्तत्र न सज्जति॥
en: That one is the only path by which the wise man goes (with a view to attain Brahma) and by aiming at that path a superior man overcomes death and attains the object of his ambition.

sa: स द्रोणभीष्मावायातौ सहेदिति मतिर्ममा स हि दिव्यास्त्रविदं राजा सखा चाङ्गिरसो नृपः॥
en: He will be able to withstand both Drona and Bhishma. Such has been my opinion; that king is familiar with the use of celestial weapons and the king is the friend of Angiras.”

sa: न तु त्वं धर्ममुद्दिश्य तस्य वा प्रियकारणात्। एतद् दित्ससि कृष्णाय सत्येनात्मानमालभे॥
en: For the sake of virtue or for desire of pleasing him however you do not give all this to Krishna; and I speak truly that you do this for the gain of yourself.

sa: सम्प्रहृष्टो यदा शल्यो दिदित्सुरपि जीवितम्। गूढो दुर्योधनस्तत्र दर्शयामास मातुलम्॥
en: And when Shalya was very highly pleased and did not mind giving away even his life, Duryodhana, who had concealed himself there, appeared before his maternal uncle.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनः श्रुत्वा महात्मानं महारथम्। उपायान्तमभिद्रुत्य स्वयमानर्च भारत॥
en: Duryodhana, having, O son of Bharata, heard that the great-minded one, mighty in battle, was coming hastened towards him and welcomed him in person.

sa: व्यथयन्निव भूतानि कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्। शनैर्विश्रामयन् सेनां स ययौ येन पाण्डवः॥
en: He went by show marches to the place where the Pandavas were encamped, affording rest to his army and as if causing pain to the beings and shaking the earth.

sa: लताधर्मा धार्तराष्ट्राः शाला: संजय पाण्डवाः। न लता वर्धते जातु महाद्रुममनाश्रिता॥
en: The sons of Dhritarashtra are the creepers of virtue, while, O Sanjaya, the sons of Pandu are Sala trees. The creeper cannot grow without the support of a big tree.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्येवमुक्तस्तु तदा परिष्वज्य हलायुधम्। कृष्णं चापहतं ज्ञात्वा युद्धान्मने जितं जयम्॥
en: Being thus addressed he embraced him who used the plough as a weapon and knowing that Krishna had gone over to the other side he regarded as through a victory had already been achieved in battle.

sa: येन वीरः करुक्षेत्रमभ्यरक्षत् परंतपः। अमुञ्चद् धनुषस्तस्य ज्यामक्षय्यां युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The warlike Yudhishthira, the chastiser of enemies, loosened the undecaying string of bow with which he had protected the field of the Kurus (Kurukshetra).

sa: यदा नाद्रियते वाक्यं सामपूर्वं सुयोधनः। तदा मया समानीय भेदिताः सर्वपार्थिवाः॥
en: When I saw that Suyodhana did not accept my words of conciliation, I had all the rulers of the earth brought before me and tried to create disunion among them.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठो वृद्धः परममन्युमान्। उत्थाय तस्मात् प्रातिष्ठद् भीष्मः सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Having said this, the foremost of aged men among the Bharata Bhishma of true prowess got up and went away from that place, fired with great rage.

sa: प्रयच्छ राज्यार्धमपेतमोहः सवाहनं त्वं सपरिच्छदं च। ततोऽवशेषं तव जीवितस्य सहानुजस्यैव भवेन्नरेन्द्र।॥
en: With your folly removed, give over one half of the kingdom with its animals and royal garments; and the remainder will be enough for your own living and that of your younger brothers.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते वीरा बद्धनिस्त्रिंशास्तथा बद्धकलापिनः। बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणा: कालिन्दीमभितो ययुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Those heroes equipped with swords and finger-protectors made of Iguna leather and furnished with weapons and quivers proceeded in the direction of the river Kalindi.

sa: निर्जने मृगसंकीर्णे नानादुमलताकुले। लताप्रतानबहुले नानागुल्मसमावृते॥
en: Solitary, abounding in wild animals, filled with various trees, creepers, entwining creepers and various groves.

sa: सुखोचितमदुःखार्ह सुकुमारं महारथम्। अपि जातु महाबाहो पश्येयं नकुलं पुनः॥
en: Shall I behold again this Nakula, O you with long arms, that great car-warrior, brought up in luxury, deserving of every happiness and undeserving of all woe.

sa: बाह्रीको मातुलकुलं त्यक्त्वा राज्यं समाश्रितः। पितृभ्रातृन् परित्यज्य प्राप्तवान् परमर्द्धिमत्॥
en: Balhika, too giving up his kingdom, established himself in the family of his maternal uncle, and abandoning his father and brother he obtained a very wealthy kingdom.

sa: महाजिनसम्पन्ना सर्वकामैः सुपूजिता। ईश्वरी सर्वकल्याणी द्रौपदी कथमच्युत॥
en: O Achyuta, how is the all blessed queen Draupadi of illustrious birth well gratified with the fulfillment of all her desires?

sa: देवापिरभवच्छेष्ठो बाह्रीकस्तदनन्तरम्। तृतीयः शान्तनुस्तात धृतिमान मे पितामहः॥
en: Of them Devapi was the foremost (eldest) and then came Balhika; and the third Shantanu; that wise man was my grandfather.

sa: कच्चिद् वृत्तिं श्वशुरेषु भद्राः कल्याणी वर्तध्वमनृशंसरूपाम्। स्तथा वृत्तिमात्मनः स्थापयध्वम्॥
en: O gentle ladies, is your treatment towards your fathers-in-law gentle and considerate? You should secure for yourself such behaviour as will make your husbands kind towards you."

sa: पाण्डवान् समरे पञ्च हनिष्यामः शितैः शरैः। ततो राजन् महायज्ञैर्विविधैर्भूरिदक्षिणैः॥
en: We shall kill the five sons Pandu in battle by means of sharp-edged arrows; then, Oking, with a great sacrificial ceremony with large present of many sorts

sa: सशङ्खघोषः सतलत्रघोषो गाण्डीवधन्वा मुहुरुद्वहंश्च। यदा शरानर्पयिता तवोरसि तदा मनस्ते किमिवाभविष्यत्॥
en: Think yourself what will then happen when that heroes, armed with Gandiva and with gloves reverberating with the strokes of his bow string, will repeatedly pierce your breast with arrows.

sa: गदाहस्तं भीममभिद्रवन्तं माद्रीपुत्रौ सम्पतन्तौ दिशश्च। अमर्षजं क्रोधविषं वमन्तौ दृष्ट्वा चिरं तापमुपैष्यसेऽधम॥
en: Beholding Bhima advance towards you with mace in his hands and the two sons of Madri range in all quarters vomiting forth the venom of their ire, you shall meet with everlasting repentance.

sa: अजातशत्रुस्तु विहाय पापं जीर्णां त्वचं सर्प इवासमाम्। विरोचतेऽहार्यवृत्तेन वीरो युधिष्ठिरस्त्वयि पापं विसृज्या॥
en: The hero Yudhishthira, who has created no enemies, casting away all sins as a snake does its worn out slough, which cannot remain on it, shines resplendent having transferred (the effect of) his sins to you.

sa: विदिते चास्य कुर्वीत कार्याणि सुलघून्यपि। एवं विचरतो राज्ञि न क्षतिर्जायते क्वचित्॥
en: One about the king should perform the act, however greatly insignificant may be in his presence. There would be no harm to him should he behave himself towards the king in the way.

sa: यस्य लोभाभिभूतस्य मतिं समनुवर्तसे। अनार्यस्याकृतज्ञस्य लोभेन हृतचेतसः॥
en: Whose inclination overpowered by avarice you follow? He leads a dishonest life, is ungrateful and deprived of his senses by avarice.

sa: तन्मे विलपमानस्य वचनं समुपेक्षसे। कोऽयं दुर्योधनो नाम कुलेऽस्मिन् कुलपांसनः॥
en: on Therefore do you not treat slightingly the words spoken by me who am lamenting. Who is this one named Duryodhana in this race but a stain,

sa: ततः सर्वाः प्रजास्तात् धृतराष्ट्रं जनेश्वरम्। अन्वपद्यन्त विधिवद् यथा पाण्डं जनाधिपम्॥
en: Then did all the subjects, my dear son, duly acknowledge the sovereignty of their king in a suitable manner as they had done that of Pandu, the ruler of men.

sa: नीचैः स्थित्वा तु विदुर उपास्ते स्म विनीतवत्। प्रेष्यवत् पुरुषव्याघ्रो वालव्यजनमुक्षिपन्॥
en: Vidura then taking up an humble position in the kingdom humbly served the king like a slave fanning him with the branch of a young tree, O best among men.

sa: चक्षुः श्रोत्रे नासिकात्वक् च जिह्वा ज्ञानस्यैतान्यायतनानि जन्तोः। तानि प्रीतान्येव तान्यव्यथो दुःखहीनः प्रणुद्यात्॥
en: The eye, the ear, the nose, the touch and the tongue, these are the sources of the knowledge of animals. These are gratified if thirst is destroyed; therefore should a man cheerfully bring these under control.

sa: न त्वेव मन्ये पुरुषस्य कर्म संवर्तते सुप्रयुक्तं यथावत्। मातुः पितुः कर्मणाभिप्रसूत: संवर्धते विधिवद् भोजनेन॥
en: Others put it in a different way. (They say) that the desired effect must come out of one's acts when done properly. (Thus) the child is the outcome of the act of its father and mother and it grows by proper diet.

sa: ते देवैः सहिताः पार्था न शक्याः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। मानुषेण नरव्याघ्रा वीर्यवन्तोऽस्त्रपारगाः॥
en: The sons of Pritha, those heroic tigers among men, capable of using the weapons, united with the gods, will be incapable of being even gazed at by a human being.

sa: अथो धनंजयं ब्रूया नित्योद्युक्तं वृकोदरम्। यदर्थं क्षत्रिया सूते तस्य कालोऽयमागतः॥
en: This is the time come for the purpose, for which a Kshatriya woman brings forth a son, if you let the occasion, which is now come, slip without doing anything;

sa: विक्रमाधिगता हार्थाः क्षत्रधर्मेण जीवतः। मनो मनुष्यस्य सदा प्रीणन्ति पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: And ever gladden the hearts of men, O you best among men. Having gone there speak to him who is the foremost among all wielders of weapons,

sa: गत्वा ब्रूहि महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। अर्जुनं पाण्डवं वीरं द्रौपद्याः पदवीं चर॥
en: Namely the hero Arjuna, the son of Pandu. Follow the path pointed out by Draupadi. It is known to you that when they (Bhima and Arjuna) are enraged they are as Death himself.

sa: गदप्रद्युम्नसाम्बांश्च कालसूर्यानलोपमान्। ते वयं धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रं शकुनिना सह॥ कर्णं चैव निहत्याजावभिषेक्ष्याम पाण्डवम्। नाधर्मो विद्यते कश्चिच्छत्रून् हत्वाऽऽततायिनः॥
en: And (who can approach) Gada, Pradyumna and Samba resembling Kala, the son of the fire. We shall after killing the son of Dhritarashtra, with Shakuni and also Karna in battle appoint (as king) the Pandava. It is no sin to destroy an enemy who would have slain ourselves.

sa: श्रोतव्यं खलु वृद्धानां नाभिशङ्कीर्वचो मम। नाशयिष्यसि मा सर्वमात्मानं पृथिवी तथा॥
en: The words of the aged should be listened to; and do not treat slightingly these words of mine for otherwise will you destroy all that have, as also this earth."

sa: ततस्तद् विद्रुतं सैन्यमपयाते जयद्रथे। आदिश्यादिश्य नाराचैराजघान वृकोदरः॥
en: After Jayadratha had fled away Vrikodara, with Narachas, slew all those soldiers who were running away, marking (each one of them).

sa: व्यवस्थायां च मित्रेषु बुद्धिविक्रमयोस्तथा। त्वमेव नः कुले धर्मस्त्वं सत्यं त्वं तपो महत्॥
en: And I know the wisdom and prowess you apply to the accomplishment of your decisions in any matter regarding your friends. In our family you are virtue, you are truth and you are the great devotee.

sa: ये ईषत् कार्यो वधस्तस्य यस्य चारित्रमीदृशम्। प्रस्कन्देन प्रतिस्तधश्छिन्नमूल इव दुमः॥
en: He whose character is of this description can be killed with very little effort like a tree with all its roots cut asunder and standing only on its principal root.

sa: किरीटं सूर्यसंकाशं यस्य मूर्धन्यशोभत। वेणीविकृतकेशान्तः सोऽयमद्य धनंजयः॥
en: That Dhananjaya, whose head was decked with a diadem of solar effulgence, is now appearing with braids ending in ugly curls.

sa: तथा हि शक्यो धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रः स्वार्थं नियोक्तुं पुरुषेण तेन। अयुद्धमाकाक्षत कौरवाणां साम्नैव दुर्योधनमाह्वयध्वम्॥
en: By this means can the son of Dhritarashtra be persuaded, to enlist himself in our service, by the messenger. Let him address Duryodhana in a conciliatory tone and with the desire of the reverse of war.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच आगम्य हास्तिनपुरादुप्लव्यमरिंदमः। पाण्डवानां यथावृतं केशवः सर्वमुक्तवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The chastiser of foes having come to Upaplavya from Hastinapura, Keshava told all about what had happened to the sons of Pandu.

sa: अशुभाद्धि शुभप्रेप्सुरिष्टयज्ञः शुभव्रतः। भविष्यति जनस्तत्र यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Where the king Yudhishthira lives people, discarding all that is evil, acquire what is good only, they always perform sacrifices and observe pure vows.

sa: तैस्तर्पयित्वा प्रथमं ब्राह्मणान् मधुसूदनः। वैदविद्भ्यो ददौ कृष्णः परमद्रविणान्यपि॥
en: The slayer of Madhu having gratified the Brahmanas first, he gave first to Brahmanas conversant with the Vedas, some of that food with wealth.

sa: अकामान् कामयति यः कामयानान् परित्यजेत्। बलवन्तं च यो द्वेष्टि तमाहुर्मूढचेतसम्॥
en: He is said to be foolish-minded who desires what ought not to be desired and forsakes those that are fit to be desired and who treats stronger parties with contempt.

sa: ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च गोमुखा डम्बरास्तथा॥ पार्थैः संयुज्यमानस्य नेदुर्मत्स्यस्य वेश्मनि। भक्ष्यान्नभोज्यपानानि प्रभूतान्यभ्यहारयन्॥ गायनाख्यानशीलाच नटवैतालिकास्तथा।
en: Then conchs, cymbals, drums, trumpets and various other musical instruments were played in the palace of Virata. Various deer and animals were slain. Wines and various celestials drinks were procured and there came also many songsters, panegyrists and actors.

sa: इन्द्रं तुष्टाव चेन्द्राणी विश्रुतैः पूर्वकर्मभिः। स्तूयमानस्ततो देवः शचीमाह पुरन्दरः॥
en: And the queen of Indra propitiated Indra by reciting the deeds done by him in olden days and the god Purandara, being thus propitiated, said to Sachi.

sa: काशिराजश्च शैब्यश्च प्रीयमाणौ युधिष्ठिरे। अक्षौहिणीभ्यां सहितावागतौ पृथिवीपती॥
en: The king of Kashi and Shaivya, who were great friends of Yudhishthira, came there, each accompanied by an Akshauhini of soldiers.

sa: द्वावेव न विराजेते विपरीतेन कर्मणा। गृहस्थश्च निरारम्भः कार्यवांश्चैव भिक्षुकः॥
en: These two cannot shine owing to the inconsistency of their acts with their station viz., the householder who does not exert and the begger who is busy.

sa: न्यायागतस्य द्रव्यस्य बोद्धव्यौ द्वावतिक्रमौ। अपात्रे प्रतिपत्तिश्च पात्रे चाप्रतिपादनम्॥
