en: Of things earned by just means these two must be looked upon as abuses viz. gifts to the unworthy and refusal to the worthy.

sa: कर्ण उवाच अपि त्वां कृष्ण पश्याम जीवन्तोऽस्मान्महारणात्। समुत्तीर्णा महाबाहो वीरक्षत्रविनाशनात्॥
en: Karna said If I am alive, O Krishna, I shall see you after this great battle, destructive of Kshatriya heroes, which is come on us, O you of long arms.

sa: चत्वारि कर्माण्यभयंकराणि भयं प्रयच्छन्त्ययथाकृतानि। मानाग्निहोत्रमुत मानमौनं मानेनाधीतमुत मानयज्ञः॥
en: Four things calculated to remove fear, cause fear when improperly done-Agnihotra, the vow of silence, the vow of study and that of sacrificial ceremonies.

sa: मध्ये तिष्ठन् हस्त्यनीकस्य मन्दो रथाश्वयुक्तस्य बलस्य मूढः। दुर्योधनो मन्यते वीतभीतिः कृत्स्ना मयेयं पृथिवी जितेति॥
en: Standing in the midst of his ranks of elephants and his army composed of chariots and cavalry, that fool of dull intelligence. Duryodhana, thinks himself past the each of any fear and that he has gained his object having conquered this earth.

sa: स सुहृच्छोकदो जातः शत्रूणां हर्षवर्धनः। वारणाह्वयमासाद्य किं वक्ष्यामि जनाधिपम्॥
en: Have now become a source of sorrow to my friends and joy to my enemies. Having gone to Hastinapura, what shall I say to the king (Dhritarashtra)?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच क्षत्रतेजा ब्रह्मचारी कौमारादपि पाण्डवः। तेन संयुगमेष्यन्ति मन्दा विलपतो मम॥
en: Dhritarashtra said The son of Pandu, from his youth, has the prowess of a Kshatriya and leads the life of a Brahmachari. Those fools desire to fight with him, thought I am lamenting.

sa: ततश्चतुर्मुखो ब्रह्मा नाभिपद्माद् विनिःसृतः। तत्रोपविष्टः सहसा पद्मे लोकपितामहः॥
en: Thereupon arose from the lotus navel the four-headed deity Brahma; there on the lotus sat all on a sudden the Grandfather of the creatures.

sa: उदयास्तमने संध्ये वेदयन्ती महद्भयम्। शिवा च वाशते घोरं तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: At the conjunction of day and night namely when the sun rises and sets are seen terrific sights; the jackals tertific howls and these are the signs of a defeat.

sa: ये केचित् पार्थिवास्तत्र धार्तराष्ट्रेण संवृताः। युद्धे समागमिष्यन्ति तुमुले शस्त्रसंकुले॥
en: The few rulers of the earth, who are surrounded by the sons of Dhritarashtra, will engage in fierce fight with marks of numberless weapons on their bodies.

sa: कस्तांस्तरस्विनो भूयः संदीपयति पाण्डवान्। अर्चिष्मतो महेष्वासान् हविषा पावकानिव॥
en: Who among them are endued with activity and who are inciting the Pandavas. These great bowinen are like those pouring clarified butter on fire.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्येवमुक्त्वा नृपतिं सर्वपापहरो हरः। उमापतिः पशुपतिर्यज्ञहा त्रिपुरार्दनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this to the king, Hara, the destroyer of all sins, Uma's lord, Pashupati, the destroyer of (Daksha's) sacrifice, the slayer of Tripura.

sa: चेकितान: सोमदत्तं द्वैरथे योद्धमिच्छति। भोजं तु कृतवर्माणं युयुधानो युयुत्सति॥
en: Chekitana desires to fight with Somadatta in single combat, each seated on his own car; and Yuyudhana is desirous of fighting against Kritavarma of the Bhoja tribe.

sa: यस्त्वेतनि प्रमाणानि यथोक्तान्यनुपश्यति। युक्तो धर्मार्थवोर्ज्ञाने स राज्यमधिगच्छति॥
en: He who knows these prescribed in books) is versed in the sciene of morality and earthly good and retains his kingdom.

sa: यो वेद मानुषं व्यूहं दैवं गान्धर्वमासुरम्। स तत्र सेनाप्रमुखे धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः॥
en: He, who is acquainted with the human system of fight, is celestial and is followed by the Gandharvas and by the Asuras that great car-warrior, Dhrishtadyumna, is at the head of that army.

sa: पुष्पं पुष्पं विचिन्वीत मूलच्छेदं न कारयेत्। मालाकार इवारामे न यथाऽङ्गारकारकः॥
en: Carefully plucking the flowers, one should not hurt the roots of the plants, like a maker of garlands in garden in a garden and not like a seller of charcoal.

sa: ताः सदा तं महात्मानं संतोषयितुमुद्यताः। ऋषि भरतशार्दूल नृत्यगीतविशारदाः॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata, they, well-versed in the art of singing and dancing, always engaged in encompassing the pleasure of the high-souled Rishi.

sa: संसरन्ति दिशः सर्वा यशसोऽस्य इवांशवः। उदितस्येव सूर्यस्य तेजसोऽनु गभस्तयः॥
en: As the sun rays spread in all directions on sun rise due to radiation, his fame with its nectar pouring white rays is spreading in all directions.

sa: भीमसेनानुरोधाय हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः। आत्मप्रतिकृति तस्मिन् ध्वज आरोपयिष्यति॥
en: At the request of Bhimasena, Hanumat, the son of the god of wind, will place his own figure on that banner.

sa: अथ मत्स्योऽब्रवीत् कवं देवरूपमिव स्थितम्। मरुद्गणैरुपासीनं त्रिदशानामिवेश्वरम्॥
en: Then the king of Matsya's said to Kanka, who was seated there like the king of gods attended by the Maruts.

sa: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च पाण्डवार्थं समागताः। पादौ तव ग्रहीष्यन्ति सर्वे चान्धकवृष्णयः॥
en: The five Pandava brothers will accept your feet, as also the five sons of Draupadi as also the son of Subhadra who has never sustained a defeat.

sa: अथ दुर्योधनः कृष्ण शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। संध्यां तिष्ठन्तमभ्येत्य दाशार्हमपराजितम्॥ आचक्षेतां तु कृष्णस्य धृतराष्ट्र सभागतम्। कुरूंश्च भीष्मप्रमुखान् राज्ञः सर्वाश्च पार्थिवान्॥ त्वामर्थयन्ते गोविन्द दिवि शक्रमिवामराः। तावभ्यनन्दद् गोविन्दः साम्ना परमवल्गुना॥
en: Duryodhana and Shakuni the son of Subala coming to Krishna, that scion of the Dasharha race and who had never met with a defeat, while he was yet performing his morning devotions, said to him-"King Dhritarashtra is come to the Assembly-Hall and so have the other Kurus headed by Bhishma and all the rulers of the earth. O Govinda, they are waiting for you like the gods in heaven waiting for Shakra." Govinda welcomed them by courteous words.

sa: तेषु संत्रस्यमानेषु कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। प्रत्यभाषन्महाबाहुं भीमसेनमरिंदमम्॥
en: Beholding them thus terrified Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, said to the mighty-armed Bhimasena, the slayer of enemies.

sa: मत्स्यराजः परामृष्टस्त्रिगर्तेन सुशर्मणा। तं मोचय महाबाहो न गच्छेद् द्विषतां वशम्॥
en: The king of Matsya has been captivated by Susharman, the king of Trigartas; O you of mighty arms, release him so that he may not be subject to the enemies.

sa: हित्वा स भगवाँल्लङ्कामाविशद् गन्धमादनम्। गन्धर्वयक्षानुगतो रक्षःकिम्पुरुषैः सह॥
en: That Divine one leaving Lanka and followed by Gandharva, Yakshas, Rakshasas and Kinnaras went to live on the mor atain Gandhamadana.

sa: पितृपक्षे च ते पार्था मातृपक्षे च वृष्णयः। द्वौ पक्षावभिजानीहि त्वमेतौ पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: On your father's side are the sons of Pritha and on your mother's side are the Vrishnis; and know that these two races to belong to your own side, O best among men.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स्वधर्मे स्थिरता स्थैर्य धैर्यमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः। स्नानं मनोमलत्यागो दानं वै भूतरक्षणम्॥
en: Yudhishthira replied Steadiness consists in remaining firmly in one's own religion. Control over passions is called patience. True ablution consists in the purification of the mind. Preservation of all creatures is true charity.

sa: अलं युद्धेन तैर्वीरैः शाम्य त्वं कुरुवृद्धये। मा गमः ससुतामात्यः सबलश्च पराभवम्॥
en: That there is no necessity to fight with these heroes; make peace for the sake of prosperity of the Kurus; do not invite along with your sons and ministers and your army, defeat.

sa: सहाया ब्राह्मणा यस्य धृतिमन्तो जितेन्द्रियाः। तमुग्रतपसं वीरं कथं जेष्यसि पाण्डवम्॥
en: Him on whose side Brahmanas, endued with wisdom and who have controlled their senses, have declared themselves, how can you defeat that son of Pandu, that hero of rigid austerities.

sa: स्फीतमाक्रम्य ते राष्ट्र राज्यमिच्छन्ति पाण्डवाः॥ दत्तं हुतमधीतं च ब्राह्मणास्तर्पिता धनैः।
en: The Pandavas are prepared to attack your prosperous territories wishing the kingdom for themselves. Gifts have been made, the holy books studied, and Brahmanas gratified with wealth by us two.

sa: ज्येष्ठो रामोऽभवत् तेषां रमयामास हि प्रजाः। मनोहरतया धीमान् पितुर्हदयनन्दनः॥
en: (And) among them his intelligent eldest son, who gladdened the heart of his father and delighted his subjects, was named Rama on account of his sweet disposition.

sa: वार्यमाणोऽपि पापेभ्यः पापात्मा पापमिच्छति। चोद्यमानोऽपि पापेन शुभात्मा शुभमिच्छति॥
en: A wicked-souled man inclines to wicked deeds though dissuaded from them and a virtuous-souled man, though urged to vice, desires to do good deeds.

sa: न तु नः क्लिश्यमानानामुपेक्षेत युधिष्ठिरः। जुगुप्सति ह्यधर्मेण मामेवोद्दिश्य कारणम्॥
en: Yudhishthira will never adopt an attitude of indifference towards ourselves, when distressed; he blames me by ascribing unrighteousness, thinking me to be the cause (of the war).

sa: मणिकाञ्चनचित्राणि समाजह्वस्ततस्ततः। तेषु तत्रोपविष्टेषु गृहीतार्धेषु भारत॥
en: Embroidered with gold and set with gems. After they had accepted due worship and seated themselves, O Bharata.

sa: मित्रामात्यैः सुसम्पन्नः सम्पन्नो युद्धयोजकैः। भ्रातृभिः श्वशुरैर्वीरैरुपपन्नो महारथैः॥ धृत्या च पुरुषव्याघ्रो नैभृत्येन च पाण्डवः। अनृशंसो वदान्यश्च ह्रीमान् सत्यपराक्रमः॥ बहुश्रुतः कृतात्मा च वृद्धसेवी जितेन्द्रियः। तं सर्वगुणसम्पन्नं समिद्धमिव पावकम्॥
en: With friends and counselors and surrounded by men prepared for battle and also by brothers, fathers-in-law who are all excellent heroes and eminent car-warriors, the son of Pandu, that tiger among men, is also graced with patience, secrecy, humanity, benevolence, modesty, truth and prowess, versed in the knowledge of holy books, having self-control, attending to the old, is that one who has subdued his senses and is possessed of every virtue and he is like a blazing fire.

sa: अमानुषं मनुष्येन्द्रैर्जालं विततमन्तरा। न मे सैन्यास्तरिष्यन्ति ततः क्रोशामि संजय॥
en: On a superhuman net (of arrows) being spread over my army, they will not be able to get out of it; therefore do I weep, O Sanjaya.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पाञ्चाल्यः क्रूरकर्मा महारथः। मामकेषु रणं कर्ता बलेषु परमास्त्रवित्॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna, the king of Panchalas, of cruel deeds and a mighty car-warrior and well acquainted with the use of superior weapons, too, will fight with my army.

sa: हिंसा बलमसाधूनां राज्ञां दण्डविधिर्बलम्। शुश्रूषा तु बलं स्त्रीणां क्षमा गुणवतां बलम्॥
en: Malice is the strength of the unrighteous; the penal code is the strength of the kings; ministration to the sick is the strength of women; and forgiveness is the strength of the virtuous.

sa: राजा लक्षणसम्पन्नस्त्रैलोक्यस्यापि यो भवेत्। शिष्यस्ते शासिता सोऽस्तु धृतराष्ट्रा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: A king with auspicious marks and the ruler of the three worlds, Yudhishthira waits on your commands, O Dhritarashtra; let him be the ruler of the earth.

sa: वित्रस्ता बहुधा सेना भारती प्रतिभाति मे। यथा कक्षं महानग्निः प्रदहेत् सर्वतश्चरन्। महार्चिरनिलोद्भूतस्तद्वद् धक्ष्यति मामकान्॥
en: My army consisting of numerous forces are flying away in all directions. As a great fire raging in all directions burns up withered grass urged by the wind, so will the great fire (in the shape of Arjuna's weapons) consume my army.

sa: कुरु वाक्यं पितुर्मातुरस्माकं च हितैषिणाम्। त्वय्यायत्तो महाबाहो शमो व्यायाम एव च।॥
en: Listen therefore to the advice of your father and of your mother as also of ourselves for we desire your wellbeing. At your discretion, O you of long arms, lies peace or war.

sa: ज्योतींषि प्रतिकूलानि दारुणा मृगपक्षिणः। उत्पाता विविधा वीर दृश्यन्ते क्षत्रनाशनाः॥
en: The stars and planets are against us; animals and birds of ill omen as also many sorts of disturbances portending the massacre of the Kshatriyas are seen.

sa: यज्ञो दानमध्ययनं तपश्च चत्वार्येतान्यन्ववेतानि सद्भिः। दमः सत्यमार्जवमानृशंस्यं चत्वार्येतान्यनुयान्ति सन्तः।।
en: Sacrificial ceremonies, gifts, study and devotion, these tour are followed by the good. Self-control, truth, kindness and humanity, these four are also the attributes of the good.

sa: ददाम्यलंकृताः कन्या वसूनि विविधानि च। मनसश्चाप्यभिप्रेतं युद्धे शत्रुनिबर्हणाः॥
en: O repressors of foes in battle, I shall center upon you women adorned with ornaments, plentiful riches and other things that you may like.

sa: प्रज्ञामेवागमयति यः प्राज्ञेभ्यः स पण्डितः। प्राज्ञो ह्यवाप्य धर्मार्थों शक्नोति सुखमेधितुम्॥
en: He that assimilates the wisdom of the wise is himself wise; and he who is wise by doing acts, both virtuous and conducive to worldly benefits, succeeds in gaining happiness.

sa: अवमन्य ततः सर्वं स्वरूपं प्रत्यपद्यत। सान्त्वयामास वैदेहीमिति राक्षसपुङ्गवः॥
en: But that foremost of the Rakshasas disregarding all those things and assuming his natural shape began to cheer up the Princess of Videha saying,

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच सखा दशरथस्यासीज्जटायुरुणात्मजः। गृध्रराजो महावीरः सम्पातिर्यस्य सोदरः॥
en: Markandeya said : The highly-powerful lord of the vultures, Jatayu, the son of Aruna and the brother of Sampati was a friend of Dasharatha's.

sa: न जीयते चानुजिगीषतेऽन्यान् न वैरकृच्चाप्रतिघातकश्चा निन्दाप्रशंसासु समस्वभावो न शोचते हृष्यति नैव चायम्॥
en: (Such a man) does vanquish others nor is vanquished by them; he never appears as other's enemy, nor their assailant; his mind remains calm at praise or blame; and he is unmoved by praise or blame.

sa: शूराश्च हि कृतास्त्राश्च सर्वे युद्धाभिकाक्षिणः। पाण्डवास्तावकाश्चैव तान् रक्ष महतो भयात्॥
en: They are heroes who have mastered the use of weapons and all of them are desirous of war-these sons of Pandu and of yourself; save them from a great calamity,

sa: गर्हयन्नेव रामस्तु त्वरितस्तं समासदत्। अपि जीवति वैदेही नेति पश्यामि लक्ष्मणा॥
en: Having quickly come upto Lakshmana whom he was still reproving, he said “O Lakshmana, is the princess of Videha still alive? I am afraid I shall see her no more."

sa: यदेतत् संविजानासि यदि सम्यग् ब्रवीम्यहम्। कृत्वासौम्यमिवात्मानं जयायोत्तिष्ठ संजय॥
en: If you are confident that I have spoken the truth, then rise up, O Sanjaya, tranquilizing your mind with a view to gain victory.

sa: अविक्षतशरीराश्चाप्यप्रमृष्टशरासनाः। असंज्ञा भुवि संगम्य किं शेध्वमपराजिताः॥
en: O unvanquished ones, with your bodies unwounded and bows untouched, why do you lie insensible embracing the earth”?

sa: अस्त्रे द्रोणार्जुनसमं वायुवेगसमं जवे। महेश्वरसमं क्रोधे को हन्याद् भीममाहवे॥
en: In arms equal of Drona and Arjuna and in speed having the force of wind, in wrath equal to Maheshvara himself, who will kill Bhima in battle.

sa: हरणं चैव वैदेह्या मम चायमुपप्लवः। राज्यभ्रंशश्च भवतस्तातस्य मरणं तथा॥
en: Your exile from the kingdom, the death of our father, the loss of the princess of Videha and (lastly) this my dangerous condition have quite overpowered me.

sa: न्यालोक्य पूर्णौधनिभानि पार्थः। हंसो यथा मेघमिवापतन्तं धनंजयः प्रत्यतपत् तरस्वी॥
en: As the sun heats up severely the cluster of clouds, Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti began attacking fiercely that Kauravas army return then like a unsurprising flood.

sa: न त्वामेवंविधो भावः स्प्रष्टुमर्हति मानद। आत्मवन्तमिव व्याधिः पुरुषं वृद्धशीलिनम्॥
en: “O respector of those that deserve honour, this state of your mind is as unworthy of you, as diseases in a self-contained old man of regular habits.

sa: ये मे निराकृता नित्यं रिपुर्येषामहं सदा॥ तैर्मोक्षितोऽहं दुर्बुद्धिर्दत्तं तैरेव जीवितम्।
en: Alas, they that were ever persecuted by me, they that were my everlasting enemies, released me from captivity! Wretch that I am, I am indebted to them for my life!

sa: ये धर्ममनुपश्यन्तस्तूष्णीं ध्यायन्त आसते। ते सत्यमाहुर्धर्म्य च न्याय्यं च भरतर्षभ॥
en: Those, who are adopting a calm attitude and are silently waiting for virtue to assert itself, have said what is righteous, true and just, 0 best of the Bharata race.

sa: यश्चैवाप्रतिमो वीर्ये धृष्टकेतुर्महायशाः। दुःसहः समरे क्रुद्धः शैशुपालिमहारथः॥ तेन वश्चेदिराजन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत। अक्षौहिण्या परिवृतः पाण्डवान् योऽभिसंश्रितः॥
en: Dhrishtaketu of great fame, who is of unparalleled strength, who wrathful in battle is hard to vanquish, that son of Shishupala, a great car-warrior, with him, the king of the Chedis who has come and joined the Pandavas with an Akshauhini, will the Pandavas fight.

sa: निषेव्य वारि पम्पायास्तर्पयित्वा पितृनपि। प्रतस्थतुरुभौ वीरौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: And both those heroic brothers Rama and Lakshmana bathing in the waters of the Pampa and offering oblations to their ancestors left (for Rishyamukha).

sa: त्वन्मुखानकरोद् राजन् न च त्वामत्यवर्तत। तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य सौबलेन जिहीर्षता॥
en: And yet he remained under your protection and never disregarded you; such a man as he, was recently, sought to be robbed by the son of Subala.

sa: यमाहुर्वेदविद्वांसो वरार्हमपराजितम्। नारायणमचिन्त्यं च तेन कृष्णेन रक्ष्यते॥
en: He is protected by Krishna who is styled by those learned in the Vedas, the unvanquished Boar and the inconceivable Narayana.

sa: अथैनमुपसंगम्य स्त्रीमध्यात् सा तपस्विनी। व्रीडमानेव शनकैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then stepping out from the midst of the women, the poor (princess) bashfully and gently gave vent to the following words.

sa: मातोवाच अतो मे भूयसी नन्दिर्यदेवमनुपश्यसि। चोद्यं मां चोदयस्येतद् भृशं वै चोदयामि ते॥
en: The mother said It is indeed a matter of great pleasure to me that you understand what I say. You urge me in my duty and therefore should I urge you all the more in yours.

sa: श्रूयेते तौ महात्मानौ नरनारायणावुभौ। तपो घोरमनिर्देश्य तप्यते गन्धमादने॥
en: We hear that both of them, Nara and Narayana of large souls, are practicing severe austerities in some hidden regions in the Gandhamadana (mountain).

sa: इत्युक्तः प्राह सुग्रीवो भ्रातरं हेतुमद् वचः। प्राप्तकालममित्रघ्नो रामं सम्बोधयन्निव॥
en: Thus addressed (by Bali), Sugriva, the slayer of his foes, as if addressing Rama himself, spoke to his brother these significant words, (well) suited to the occasion.

sa: राम उवाच उच्यमानस्तथापि स्म भूय एवाभ्यभाषत्। पुनः पुनः क्षम्यमाणः सान्त्व्यमानश्च भारत॥ दम्भोद्भवो युद्धमिच्छन्नाह्वयत्येव तापसौ।
en: Rama said Though spoken to in this way, he repeated his request and the ascetics, O Bharata, again and again comforted him and pardoned him (for his importunities). Dambhodbhava, desirous of battle, however summoned these two devotees to fight again and again.

sa: दम्भोद्भव उवाच यद्येतदस्त्रमस्मासु युक्तं तापस मन्यसे॥ एतेनापि त्वया योत्स्ये युद्धार्थी ह्यहमागतः।
en: Dambhodbhava said If, O devotee, you think this weapon fit to be used against me and mine, I shall fight with you though you use that weapon. I am come here for fight.

sa: तमुदीक्ष्य समायान्तं कौन्तेयः परवीरहा। प्रत्यगृह्णात् प्रहृष्टात्मा धाराधरमिवाचलः॥
en: Seeing him approach, that slayer of hostile heroes, the son of Kunti received him gladly like a hill receiving a cloud.

sa: द्योतयन्ती दिशः सर्वाः पृथिवीं च समन्ततः॥ तथा दश दिशः सर्वाः पतद्गाण्डीवमावृणोत्। नागाश्च रथिनः सर्वे मुमुहुस्तत्र भारत॥
en: Gandiva bow had covered all the ten directions in number, by shooting volley of arrows as the lightening glows in sky while raining and it illumines all directions including the earth from all sides. O Barata! all soldiers including elephant riders and car riders were loosing their conscious.

sa: हिरण्यकण्ठी: प्रमदा ग्रामान् वा बहुगोकुलान्। किं ददानीति तं विप्रमुवाचाधिरथिस्ततः॥
en: Then the (adopted) son of Adhiratha said to that Brahmana "Between beautiful damsels adorned with golden necklaces and villages full of cows which shall I give you?”

sa: धार्तराष्ट्राः पाण्डवान् पालयन्तु पाण्डोः सुतास्तव पुत्रांश्च पान्तु। एकारिमित्राः कुरवो ह्येककार्या जीवन्तु राजन् सुखिनः समृद्धाः॥
en: Let the sons of Dhritarashtra, therefore, make friends of the sons of Pandu; and let the sons of Pandu make friends with your sons; let the Kurus and Pandus live having the same friends and foes, o king, being happy and prosperous.

sa: संयच्छ मामकानश्वांस्तथैव त्वं बृहन्नले। कुरुभिर्योत्स्यमानस्य गोधनानि परीप्सतः॥
en: Who am desirous of fighting with the Kurus and rescuing the precious kine. You were formerly the favourite charioteer of Arjuna.

sa: एतमाश्रित्य पुत्रस्ते मन्दबुद्धिः सुयोधनः। अवामन्यत तान् वीरान् देवपुत्रानरिंदमान्॥
en: Your son Suyodhana of weak intellect depending on him for support has insulted those heroic sons of godly men, the subduer of their foes.

sa: अभिप्रायं यो विदित्वा तु भर्तुः सर्वाणि कार्याणि करोत्यतन्द्री। वक्ता हितानामनुक्त आर्य: शक्तिज्ञः आत्मेव हि सोऽनुकम्प्यः॥
en: He, who after knowing the intentions of his lord, does all acts with promptitude and who though honorable and devoted to his master says what is conducive to his interests and knows his own strength, is to be regarded as his (the lord's) own self.

sa: इन्द्रो वृत्रवधेनैव महेन्द्रः समपद्यत। माहेन्द्रं च गृहं लेभे लोकानां चेश्वरोऽभवत्॥
en: Indra became the great Indra only by slaying Vritra and obtained the lordship over the gods and the celestial cup for drinking wine and became the lord of the worlds.

sa: तमिन्द्रो ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा भिक्षां देहीत्युपस्थितः। स्वागतं चेति राधेयस्तमथ प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: (For this reason) disguised as a Brahmana Indra came to him and said "give me alms." And the son of Radha replied to him "you are welcome."

sa: एष देवान् सहेन्द्रेण जित्वा परपुरञ्जयः। अतर्पयन्महाबाहुरर्जुनो जातवेदसम्॥
en: This Arjuna, the conqueror of hostile cities, of long arms gratified the god of fire by conquering the gods with Indra.

sa: योऽसौ कुलाधमो मूढो मया राज्येऽभिषेचितः। सर्ववानरगोपुच्छा यमृक्षाश्च भजन्ति वै॥
en: That stupid wretch of his race whom I have installed on the throne (of Kishkindha) and to whom all the monkeys, apes and bears pay their homage,

sa: ततः पार्थमभिद्रुत्य दुःसहः सविविंशतिः। अवाकिरच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैः परीप्सुर्धातरं रणे॥
en: With a view to rescue his brother in battle, Dussaha, accompanied by Vivinshati, approached Partha and covered him with sharp arrows.

sa: नातिदूरमथो गत्वा मत्स्यपुत्रधनंजयौ। अवेक्षताममित्रघ्नौ कुरूणां बलिनां बलम्॥
en: Adorned with gold necklaces, seemed to run through the sky. And not going very far, the son of Matsya and Dhananjaya.

sa: काकैरिमांश्चित्रबर्हान् मयूरान् पराजयेथाः पाण्डवान् धार्तराष्ट्रैः। हित्वा सिंहान् क्रोष्टकान् गृहमान: प्राप्ते काले शोचिता त्वं नरेन्द्रः॥
en: By the help of these sons of Dhritarashtra who are like crows you desire to subdue the Pandavas who are as peacocks with variegated plumage. Forsaking the lions you are protecting the jackals. When the time comes, you will repent for it.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच जगाम शक्रस्तच्छुत्वा यत्र तौ तेपतुस्तपः। सार्धं देवगणः सर्वैर्वृहस्पतिपुरोगमैः॥
en: Shakra having heard this went to the place where these two were practicing their devotions, in company with all that host of gods with Brihaspati going in front of them.

sa: यस्मिन्नस्त्राणि दिव्यानि समस्तानि महात्मनि। आधारः सर्वविद्यानां स धारयति कुण्डले॥
en: That high-souled one, to whom all the celestials weapons are known, and who is the repository of all the sciences, is now wearing a pair of ear-rings.

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रा वनं राजन् व्याघ्राः पाण्डुसुता मताः। मा वनं छिन्धि सव्यानं मा व्याघ्रान नीनशन् वनात्॥
en: The sons of Dhritarashtra, 0 king, constitute the forest and in my opinion the Pandavas are the tigers. Do not cut down that forest with the tigers and do not let the tigers be driven away from the forest and be killed.

sa: सिंहनादैश्च शूराणां गजानां बृंहितैस्तथा। गाण्डीवशब्देन भृशमशनिप्रतिमेन च।
en: By the war-cries of the heroes, the roars of elephants, by the twang of the Gandiva resembling the sound of lightning.

sa: क्षिप्तामिषीका काकाय चित्रकूटे महागिरौ। भवता पुरुषव्याघ्र प्रत्यभिज्ञानकारणात्॥
en: (Namely) that while dwelling in the mighty mountain Chitrakuta, O most valiant of meen, you shot a straw at a crow.

sa: स गाढवेदनो हित्वा रणं प्रायादुदङ्मखः। ततोऽर्जुन उदक्रोशदुत्तरश्च महारथः॥
en: Experiencing a great pain and leaving the battle-field, he fled towards the north. Then Arjuna and the mighty car-warrior Uttara began to scoff him.

sa: ततः सात्यकिमादाय पाणौ हार्दिक्यमेव च। ऋषिभिस्तैरनुज्ञातो निर्ययौ मधुसूदनः॥
en: Then taking Satyaki by his hand and also the son of Hridika the slayer of Madhu went out, with the permission of those Rishis.

sa: उपासनादुपादाय कर्णो बाणानथापरान्। विव्याध पाण्डवं हस्ते तस्य मुष्टिरशीर्यत॥
en: Then taking out other arrows from his quiver, Karna struck Arjuna with them on his hand, and the latter lost hold of his bow.

sa: सोऽमृष्यमाण: कर्णस्य निषङ्गस्यावलम्बनम्। चिच्छेद निशिताग्रेण शरेण नतपर्वणा॥
en: Unable to bear the attack of Karna, Arjuna cut off the string of his quiver with a keenedged and straight arrow.

sa: तथैवाबद्धकवचं काकोज्ज्वलकुण्डलम्। हर्यक्षं वृषभस्कन्धं यथास्य पितरं तथा॥
en: And like his father he was clad in armour, adorned with brilliant golden ear-rings, endued with leonine eyes and bovine shoulders.

sa: वनं राजंस्तव पुत्रोऽऽम्बिकेय सिंहान् वने पाण्डवांस्तात विद्धि। सिंहैविहीनं हि वनं विनश्येत् सिंहा विनश्येयुर्ऋते वनेन॥
en: O king, your son is a forest, O son of Ambika, O sire, know that the Pandavas are the trees in that forest. Deserted by the lions, the forest will be destroyed; and the lions also will be destroyed without the forest.

sa: यस्योदकं मधुपर्कं च गां च न मन्त्रवित् प्रतिगृह्णाति गेहे। लोभाद् भयादथ कार्पण्यतो वा तस्यानर्थं जीवितमाहुरायः॥
en: He, whose water, honey, curds and kine, one versed in the Mantras (Brahmana) does not accept either owing to fear (on the part of the Brahmana) or to unwillingness and miserliness (on the part of the host), lives in vain; which the wise have declared.

sa: गिरिकूटनिभाङ्गानां सिंहानामिव गर्जताम्। श्रूयते तुमुलः शब्दस्तत्र तत्र प्रधावताम्॥
en: A great tumultuous uproar was heard there caused by those monkeys running hither and thither, having bodies huge as mountain-peaks and roaring like lions.

sa: जानन्तोऽस्य प्रकृति केशवस्य न्ययोजयन् दस्युवधाय कृष्णम्। मैश्वर्यवान् सिद्धिषु वासुदेवः॥
en: And knowing his nature, they employed Krishna far slaying that wicked being. And Vasudeva undertook (endued with all kinds of prosperity), the accomplishment of that difficult task.

sa: अथवा कीचकस्याहं पोथयामि पदा शिरः। ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तस्य क्रीडन्निव महाद्विपः॥
en: Or like a mighty elephant I would have easily crushed with a single kick the head of Kichaka intoxicated with the pride of wealth.

sa: तत्रान्ये व्याहरन्ति स्म वानरा बहुमानिनः। समर्था लङ्घने सिन्धोर्न तु तत् कृत्स्नकारकम्॥
en: There at, very many self-conceited monkeys said "we are capable of crossing the sea.” But this could not serve the purpose fully (as all the monkeys were not able to cross the sea).

sa: ब्रूहि किं ते करोम्यत्र साहाय्यं पुरुषर्षभ। ऐक्ष्वाको ह्यस्मि ते ज्ञातिरिति रामस्तमब्रवीत्॥
en: "O most valiant of men, tell me what assistance I shall render to you. I belong to the race of Ikshvaku and can therefore claim kinship with you." Rama (then) replied to him.

sa: उपातिष्ठत पाञ्चाली वासितेव नरर्षभम्॥ सा लतेव महाशालं फुल्लं गोमतितीरजम्।
en: The daughter of Panchala embraced the second son of Pandu even as a creeper embraces a vigorous and huge Sala tree on the banks of the Gomati.

sa: भीष्मद्रोणमुखास्तत्र कुरवो रथिसत्तमाः। वित्रस्तमनसः सर्वे धनंजयकृताद् भयात्॥
en: All the mighty car-warriors of the Kurus headed by Bhishma and Drona had their minds agitated by the fear of Dhananjaya.

sa: अरण्ये निःशलाके वा तत्र मन्त्रोऽभिधीयते। नासुहृत् परमं मन्त्रं भारतार्हति वेदितुम्॥
en: Or proceeding to a forest shorn of grass, one should think of his purposes. One who is not a friend, O Bharata, should not be made aware of important secrets.

sa: ऐरावणोऽस्मात् सलिलं गृहीत्वा जगतो हितः। मेघेष्वामुञ्चते शीतं यन्महेन्द्रः प्रवर्षति॥
en: Airavata, taking up cold water from here for the good of the world, gives them to the clouds and the great Indra showers this water as rain.

sa: अत्र सूर्यांशुभिर्भिन्नाः पातालतलमाश्रिताः। मृता हि दिवसे सूत पुनर्जीवन्ति वै निशि॥
en: Some beings, living in this nether world, the Patalam, pierced by the rays of the sun, are dead in the day time, O Suta and are revived again at night.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विदुरेणैवमुक्तस्तु केशवः शत्रुपूगहा। दुर्योधनं धार्तराष्ट्रमभ्यभाषत वीर्यवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said This being said Vidura, Keshava the killer of his crowds of enemies, endued with prowess, said to Duryodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: तं न बुद्ध्यसि गोविन्दं घोरविक्रममच्युतम्। आशीविषमिव क्रुद्धं तेजोराशिमनिन्दितम्॥
en: You do not know and fully understand this Achyuta, this Govinda of Fierce prowess; he is endued with unblamable energy like an angry serpent.

sa: नाधर्मश्चरितः कश्चित् त्वया भवति भाविनि। अधर्मं कुत एवाहं वरेयं लोककाम्यया॥
en: You will, O beauteous girl, on no account fall away from virtue (by satisfying my desire). How can I, who seek the welfare of everybody commit an act of sin?

sa: अनेन हि हता बाल्ये पूतना शकुनी तथा। गोवर्धनो धारितश्च गवार्थं भरतर्षभ।४६॥
en: When he was but a child, Putana and Shakuni were slain by him and the Govardhana mountain was held up by him for the protection of the cows, O best among the Bharatas.

sa: अगदस्त्वथ लङ्काया द्वारदेशमुपागतः। विदितो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य प्रविवेश गतव्यथः॥
en: Angada having reached one of the gates of Lanka and being made known to the Rakshasa king entered (the city) fearlessly.

sa: ततोऽर्धचन्द्रमावृत्य तेन पार्थः समागमत्। वारणेनेव मत्तेन मत्तो वारणयूथपः॥
en: Then drawing his bow to the shape of a crescent, Partha proceeded as an infuriated leader of an elephant herd when met by another.

sa: दह्यतामिव वेणूनामासीत् परपुरंजय॥ हयानस्यार्जुनः सर्वान् कृतवानल्पजीवितान्।
en: Like that of bamboo's when on fire. O conqueror of enemies' cities, greatly assailed by Arjuna, his horses.

sa: तेवैर्मनुष्यैर्गन्धर्वैरसुरैरुरगैश्च यः। न सोढुं समरे शक्यस्तं न बुद्ध्यसि केशवम्॥
en: You do not know that Keshava is incapable of being fought with in battle by the gods, the human beings, the Gandharvas, the Asuras and the Nagas.

sa: नृशंस पापभूयिष्ठ क्षुद्रकर्मसहायवान्। पापैः सहायैः संहत्य पापं कर्म चिकीर्षसि॥
en: "O you of inhuman, of exceeding sinfulness, having for your supporters only men of small deeds, united with wicked men, you want to perpetrate a wicked deed.

sa: कीर्यमाणे तदा द्रोणे शरैर्गाण्डीवधन्वना। हाहाकारो महानासीत् सैन्यानां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of Bharatas, beholding Drona entirely enveloped with shafts shot by the holder of the Gandiva bow, the army set a mighty lamentation.

sa: तं द्रक्ष्यसि परिभ्रष्टं तस्मात् त्वमचिरादिव। ऐश्वर्यमदसम्मूढं बलिं लोकत्रयादिव॥
en: You shall soon see him fallen from that lordship, even as foolish Vali, who was proud of his power fallen from the three worlds.

sa: राघवस्तु विनिर्यान्तं व्यढानीकं दशाननम्। बार्हस्पत्यं विधिं कृत्वा प्रत्यव्यूहनिशाचरम्॥
en: And the descendant of Raghu also, seeing the ten-headed advance, opposed the nightranger by drawing up his army after the manner recommended by Brihaspati.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच गम्यतां भगवंस्तत्र यत एवागतो ह्यसि। कौतूहलात् समाहूतः प्रसीद भगवन्निति॥
en: Kunti said: O god, go to that place from which you have come. It is through curiosity that you have been invoked. O worshipful one, pardon me (for my folly).

sa: आगतोऽस्मि वशं भद्रे तव मन्त्रबलात्कृतः। किं करोमि वशो राज्ञि ब्रूहि कर्ता तदस्मि ते॥
en: Gentle lady, drawn by the power of your Mntras, I have come under your power. Now that I have been subject to your power, tell me, Queen, what I shall do. I shall do whatever you may command me.

sa: स सम्प्रहारो ववृधे भीरूणां भयवर्धनः। लोमसंहर्षणो घोरः पुरा देवासुरे यथा।॥
en: And that battle so frightful to cowards and which makes one's hair stand erect, was as furious as that fought between the gods and the demons in days of yore.

sa: निरुद्यमा भविष्यन्ति पाण्डवाः सोमकैः सह। तस्माद् वयमिहैवैनं केशवं क्षिप्रकारिणम्॥
en: All the son of Pandu, along with the Somakas will be deprived of their energy; therefore now and here should we capture this Keshava of quick action,

sa: दिष्ट्या जीवसि गान्धारे दिष्ट्या नः सङ्गमः पुनः। दिष्ट्या त्वया जिताश्चैव गन्धर्वाः कामरूपिणः॥
en: "O son of Gandhari, fortunate it is that you are alive. Fortunate it is that we have again met. By good luck you have defeated the Gandharvas who are capable of assuming any form at will.

sa: अनेन विजितानश्वैर्दो( जयति वासवः। अनेन बलभित् पूर्वं प्रहते प्रहरत्युत॥
en: Vasava gains victories in the sky by means of the horses trained by him and the vanquisher of Bala smotes who had previously been smitten by him,

sa: ततो विनय सहसा शालस्पर्शविबोधितः॥ दोर्ध्यामादाय सुग्रीवं कुम्भकर्णोऽहरद् बलात्।
en: Then suddenly awakening at the touch of the Sala tree, Kumbhakarna, with a terrible yell, stretching forth his arms, seized Sugriva by main force.

sa: भीष्मेण हि महाप्राज्ञं पित्रा ते बाह्निकेन च। दत्तोंऽशः पाण्डुपुत्राणां भेदाद् भीतैररिंदम॥
en: O you of great wisdom, by Bhishma, by your father and by Balhika were the sons of Pandu given their share of the kingdom out fear for a dispute, O chastiser of foes.

sa: ततोऽस्मै प्राहिणोद् द्रोणः शरानधिकविंशतिम्। अप्राप्तांश्चैव तान् पार्थश्चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: Thus addressed, Drona discharged at him more than twenty shafts. But the light-handed Partha severed them all before they could fall down on him.

sa: दुर्योधनात् क्षुद्रतराच्च कर्णात्। तेषां हीमो हीनसुखप्रियाणां महात्मनां संजनयतो हि तेजः॥
en: Except the great weak-minded fool, Duryodhana and the still meaner Karna. These two alone are increasing the energy of these large-minded souls who do not desire for their own happiness.

sa: नारदस्त्वार्यकश्चैव कृतकार्यों मुदा युतौ। अभिजग्मतुरभ्यर्च्य देवराजं महाद्युतिम्॥
en: Narada and Aryaka being pleased at their success went away after worshipping the king of the gods endued with great luster.

sa: बुद्ध्या तुल्यो ह्युशनसा बृहस्पतिसमो नये। वेदास्तथैव चत्वारो ब्रह्मचर्यं तथैव च॥
en: In intelligence he is like Shukra, and in the knowledge of moral laws like Brihaspati. He is equally well-read in the four Vedas, and follows the Brahmacharya mode of life.

sa: ततो हताश्वात् प्रस्कन्ध रथात् स हतसारथिः॥ तत्रैवान्तर्दधे राजन् मायया रावणात्मजः।
en: His horses and driver being slain, he jumped down from the car; and O king, resorting to his power of illusion, the son of Ravana vanished at that very spot.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच तावुभौ पतितौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। बबन्ध रावणिर्भूयः शरैर्दत्तवरैस्तदा॥
en: Markandeya said : Seeing those two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana drop down on earth, the son of Ravana tied them in a net-work of arrows, granted to him as boons.

sa: ततस्तं देशमागम्य कृतकर्मा विभीषणः। बोधयामास तौ वीरौ प्रज्ञास्त्रेण प्रबोधितौ॥
en: Then, the successful Vibhishana arriving at that place and restoring those two heroes to consciousness by means of the weapon (named) Prajna brought them back to senses.

sa: मार्दवं सर्वभूतानामनसूया क्षमा धृतिः। आयुष्याणि बुधाः प्राहुर्मित्राणां चाविमानना॥
en: On the other hand, leaving them to be too much exercised would ruin the gods even; humility, kindness to all creatures, forgiveness and patience.

sa: विनिकृत्तभुजस्कन्धं कबन्धं भीमदर्शनम्। तं हत्वा सूतमप्यस्त्रैर्जघान बलिनां वरः॥
en: Deprived of head and arms, the trunk looked terrible. Having slain him (Indrajita), the strongest of the strong, (Lakshmana) killed his charioteer with weapons.

sa: नाहत्वा हि महाबाहो शत्रूनेति करं पुनः। सा शक्तिर्देवराजस्य शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: O mighty-armed one, that arrow of the lord of the gods does not return to the hand of the person who discharges it, without destroying hundreds and thousands of enemies.

sa: महाराज्ये स्थितो दीप्ते न स्त्रियं हन्तुमर्हसि। हतैवैषा यदा स्त्री च बन्धनस्था च ते वशे॥
en: (He said) "Placed as you are on the throne of this renowned and mighty empire, you should not kill a woman. This woman (to all intents and purposes) is already slain in as much as she is a prisoner in your power.

sa: गान्धार्युवाच आनायय सुतं क्षिप्रं राज्यकामुकमातुरम्। न हि राज्यमशिष्टेन शक्यं धर्मार्थलोपिना॥
en: Gandhari said Quickly summon your son, who is afflicted with a passion for kingdom; a kingdom cannot be maintained by an unrighteous person who seeks neither virtue nor worldly good.

sa: आसनस्थेषु सर्वेषु तेषु राजसु भारत॥ द्वा:स्थो निवेदयामास सूतपुत्रमुपस्थितम्। अयं स रथ आयाति योऽयासीत् पाण्डवान् प्रति॥ दूतो नस्तूर्णमायातः सैन्धवैः साधुवाहिभिः।
en: And to all those kings, seated on their seats, O Bharata, the gate-keeper (thus) submitted for their information, the presence of the Suta's son. Here comes he with his car who was sent to the sons of Pandu. Our messenger has returned speedily by the aid of horses of Sindhu species, which are good barriers of loads.

sa: विश्वामित्रोऽथ सम्भ्रान्तः श्रपयामास वै चरुम्। परमान्नस्य यत्नेन न च तं प्रत्यपालयत्॥
en: Vishvamitra, with great respect, employed himself in preparing Charu (rice boiled in milk and honey) and in his anxiety to prepare that excellent repast he could not attend to him in other respects.

sa: गच्छ तात महाप्राज्ञां गान्धारी दीर्घदर्शिनीम्। आनयेह तया सार्धमनुनेष्यामि दुर्मतिम्॥
en: “Go my dear friend, to the exceedingly wise Gandhari endued with great foresight; get her hare; joining with her shall I persuade that one of evil intellect.

sa: न चातिगुणवत्स्वेषा नात्यन्तं निर्गुणेषु च। नैषा गुणान् कामयते नैर्गुण्यानानानुरज्यते। उन्मत्ता गौरिवान्धा श्रीः क्वचिदेवावतिष्ठते॥
en: Nor (dose prosperity reside) in persons endued with every virtue nor in those having none; she (prosperity) dose not desire a strong combination of good qualities. Prosperity resides in some one (without any fixed rule) like a mad cow.

sa: अथ वर्षशते पूर्णे धर्मः पुनरुपागमत्। वासिष्ठं वेषमास्थाय कौशिकं भोजनेप्सया॥
en: Then on the completion of a hundred years Dharma came there again to the son of Kushika, assuming the appearance of Vasishtha with the desire of eating.

sa: अङ्गुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषो महात्मा न दृश्यते सौहृदि संनिविष्टः। अजश्चरो दिवारानमतन्द्रितश्च स तं मत्वा कविरास्ते प्रसन्नः॥
en: Of the measure of the thumb, that illustrious Being, though dwelling in the heart, cannot be seen by the eye. Though without birth, he moves about in full consciousness, day and night. He that knows him becomes wise and full of joy.

sa: श्रोतुमिच्छामि सावित्रि त्वं हि वेत्थ परावरम्। त्वां हि जानामि सावित्रि सावित्रीमिव तेजसा॥
en: We are desirous of learning all this from you who are surely acquainted with the mysteries of good and evil. For, O Savitri, we know you are as resplendent as Savitri herself (the wife of Brahma).

sa: नास्यातिवादा हृदयं तापयन्ति नानधीतं नाहुतमग्निहोत्रम्। मनो ब्राह्मी लघुतामादधीत प्रज्ञां चास्मै नाम धीरा लभन्ते। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: The heart of such a man is not grieved at calumny, nor the want of study of the holy books, nor the non-performance of sacrificial ceremonies; by a knowledge of the supreme Being those who are given to asceticism soon obtain true wisdom. The ascetics perceive that Lord who is Eternal.

sa: तदातिष्ठ रथं शीघ्रमिममैन्द्रं महायुते। ततः प्रहृष्टः काकुत्स्थस्तथेत्युक्त्वा विभीषणम्॥
en: O highly-resplendent one, therefore do you soon ascend this car of Indra." Thereupon the descendant of Kakustha gladly saying to Vibhishana “be it so,"

sa: उभौ लोकौ विद्यया व्याप्य याति तदा हुतं चाहुतमग्निहोत्रम्। मा ते ब्राह्मी लघुतामादधीत प्रज्ञानं स्यानाम धीरा लभन्ते। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: To a man of true knowledge, both the worlds are accessible and though they may not have performed the Agnihotra ceremony, yet do they obtain the fruits thereof. Do you not proclaim your deficiency in matters spiritual. True knowledge is another name of the inner soul which those who have self-control gain. The ascetics perceive that Lord who is Eternal.

sa: शूलमिन्द्राशनिप्रख्यं ब्रह्मदण्डभिवोद्यतम्। तच्छूलं सत्वरं रामश्चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Javelin like the thunder-bolt of Indra and resembling the upraised Brahmdanda. (But) Rama quickly cut off that javelin with sharpened darts.

sa: उवाच रामो वैदेही परामर्शविशङ्कितः। गच्छ वैदेहि मुक्ता त्वं यत् कार्यं तन्मया कृतम्॥
en: Rama, suspecting the loss of her virtue, addressed the daughter of the king of Mithila thus, "O Princess of Videha, go (wheresoever you like)! You are now liberated (from your captivity). I have done my duty.

sa: ततः प्रहृष्टास्त्रिदशाः सहगन्धर्वचारणाः। निहतं रावणं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा॥
en: Then the celestials accompanied by the Gandharvas and the Charanas, beholding Ravana slain by Rama. of untiring exertions were highly delighted.

sa: अक्रोधेन जयेत् क्रोधमसाधु साधुना जयेत्। जयेत् कदर्यं दानेन जयेत् सत्येन चानृतम्॥
en: Anger should be subjugated by the reverse of anger; and virtuous man should be subjugated by virtue, by gifts should a miser be subjugated, by truth one addicted to untruth should be won.

sa: उवाच च महात्मानं काकुत्स्थं दैन्यमास्थितः। प्रतीच्छ देवीं सद्वृत्तां महात्मञ्जानकीमिति॥
en: And he (Avindhya) with great humility said to the high-souled descendant of Kakustha, “O high-souled one, accept this divine lady, the daughter of Janaka, of spotless character."

sa: भोगा यस्मात् प्रतिष्ठन्ते व्याप्य सर्वान् सुरासुरान्। प्रणतो द्रष्टुमिच्छामि कृष्ण योगिनमव्ययम्॥
en: From whom flow all the enjoyments that are enjoyed by the gods and Asuras; with my head bent down I desire to see Krishna, the devotee who is without end.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य ततोऽस्त्राणि प्रहृष्टवदनोऽभवत्। अधिज्यं तरसा कृत्वा गाण्डीवं व्याक्षिपद् धनुः॥ तस्य विक्षिप्यमाणस्य धनुषोऽभून्महाध्वनिः। यथा शैलस्य महतः शैलेनैवावजघ्नतः॥
en: Quickly stringing his bow Gandiva he twanged it. Then from the twang of the bow was produced a great sound like that of a mountain clashed by another mighty one. Dreadful was the sound that filled the earth and impetuous was the wind that blew on all sides.

sa: ऊषुश्च सुचिरं कालं प्रच्छन्नाः पाण्डवास्तदा। मात्रा सहैकचक्रायां ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने॥
en: At that time did the sons of Pandu live for a long time in disguise in company with their mother in the house of a Brahmana Ekachakra.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच पुत्र नैतदिहाश्चर्यं त्वयि राजर्षिधर्मणि। साधो सद्वृत्त काकुत्स्थ शृणु चेदं वचो मम॥
en: Brahma said: O descendant of Kakustha, O son of good character, this (behaviour) is not surprising on your part, (because) you are honest and know the duties of the royal sages: (Now) hear these my words.

sa: सत्यवानुवाच अभ्यासगमनाद् भीरु पन्थानो विदिता मम। वृक्षान्तरालोकितया ज्योत्स्नया चापि लक्षये॥
en: Satyavana said : Timid girl, the paths are well known to me as I go by them often. Further, by the moonlight falling between the trees I can discern them.

sa: यस्यैतत् पाण्डुरं छत्रं विमलं मूर्ध्नि तिष्ठति॥ महतो रथवंशस्य नानाध्वजपताकिनः।
en: And over whose head is an umbrella of pure white and who stands at the head of a great collection of cars with diverse flags and pennons

sa: सदा ममैष मान्यस्तु सर्वशस्त्रभृतामपि। सुप्रसन्नं महावीरं कुरुष्वैनं प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: He is ever worshipful to me as well as to other heroes. Do you cheerfully go round him the foremost of the Kuru warriors.

sa: तूष्णीम्भूत उपासीत न चेष्टेन्मनसाऽपि च। उपावर्तस्व तद् ब्रह्म अन्तरात्मनि विश्रुतम्॥
en: Bringing all your senses under control and without any exertion of your mind in other direction), seek to know that Brahma who, you have heard, resides in your inner soul.

sa: ध्वजाङ्कुशपताकाङ्क दक्षिणं ते सुदक्षिणः। स्कन्धे निक्षिपतां बाहुं शान्तये भरतर्षभ॥
en: Let that one who has performed many sacrifices comfort you, by placing his righi arm, marked with the sign of a banner and hook on you shoulders.

sa: मत्कार्मुकविनिर्मुक्ता: पार्थमाशीविषोपमाः। शराः समभिसर्पन्तु वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः॥
en: Shot from my bow the arrows, resembling venomous snakes, will pierce Partha like serpents going through ant hills.

sa: ततस्ते प्रेक्षमाणानां तेषामक्लिष्टकर्मणाम्॥ अन्तर्धानं ययुर्देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः।
en: Then in the very sight of those heroes of untiring achievements, all the gods with Shakra at their head vanished away.

sa: नात्मानमनुशोचामि यथाहं पितरं शुभे। भर्तारं चाप्यनुगतां मातरं परिदुर्बलाम्॥
en: I do not, O auspicious girl, grieve so much for myself as for my father and my weak mother (ever) devoted to her husband.

sa: निशम्य सर्वं प्रतिपत्तुमेव। यशः परं प्राप्स्यसि जीवलोके भयं न चामुत्र न चेह तेऽस्ति।॥
en: After listening to these world of mine, if you can follow them in their entirely, you will get great fame in this world of living beings and you will never meet with fear here in this world or elsewhere.

sa: दृष्ट्वा रामं तु जानक्या संगतं शक्रसारथिः॥ उवाच परमप्रीतः सुहृन्मध्य इदं वचः। वगन्धर्वयक्षाणां मानुषासुरभोगिनाम्॥ अपनीतं त्वया दुःखमिदं सत्यपराक्रम।
en: Then the charioteer of Shakra seeing Rama united with the daughter of Janaka was well pleased and addressed him, in the midst of friends, these words. “O truly-powerful one, as you have done away with this distress of the gods, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the mortals, the Asuras and the serpents.

sa: ततः सीतां पुरस्कृत्य रामः सौमित्रिणा सह॥ सुग्रीवप्रमुखैश्चैव सहितः सर्ववानरैः। विधाय रक्षां लङ्कायां विभीषणपुरस्कृतः॥ संततार पुनस्तेन सेतुना मकरालयम्। पुष्पकेण विमानेन खेचरेण विराजता॥ कामगेन यथामुख्यैरमात्यैः संवृतो वशी।
en: Then Rama with Sita in this front and accompanied by the son of Sumitra and by all the monkeys with Sugriva at their head and preceded by Vibhishana and taking steps for the protection of Lanka and one that selfcontained (Rama) surrounded by his chief advisers in order of precedence rode on that sky-ranging car Pushpaka, moving anywhere at will re-crossed the abode of the Makaras (i.e. the ocean) by means of the same bridge.

sa: सत्यात् प्रच्यवमानानां संकल्पश्च तथा भवेत्। ततो यज्ञः प्रतायेत सत्यस्यैवावधारणात्॥
en: The purposes of those that have deviated from truth are in accordance with their condition and, so replying on the truth of the Vedas, perform sacrificial ceremonies.

sa: अथैनान् राघवः काले समानीयाभिपूजय च।॥ विसर्जयामास तदा रत्नैः संतोष्य सर्वशः।
en: Then the descendant of Raghu bringing all those (monkeys) together at the due time worshipped them all. He then dismissed them all after having satisfied them with gifts of gems.

sa: अभिवादयमानं त्वां शिरसा राजकुञ्जरः। पाणिभ्यां प्रतिगृह्णातु धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Let the virtuous king Yudhishthira, that best of kings take you by the hand while you are saluting him with your head bowed down.

sa: अत्र मूलं हिमवतो मन्दरं याति शाश्वतम्। अपि वर्षसहस्रेण न चास्यान्तोऽधिगम्यते॥
en: In this direction the base of the Himavat mountain is extended to the eternal Mandara and no one can reach the end of this mountain even in a thousand years.

sa: अतः प्रभृति सूर्यस्य तिर्यगावर्तते गतिः। अत्र ज्योतींषि सर्वाणि विशन्त्यादित्यमण्डलम्॥
en: From this place forward the sun has recourse to a straight path and here do all the luminous bodies enter the sphere of Aditi (the solar sphere).

sa: लक्षयित्वेङ्गितं सर्वं प्रियं तस्मै निवेद्य वै॥ वायुपुत्रे पुनः प्राप्ते नन्दिग्राममुपागमत्।
en: (Hanuman) then communicated to him the happy news on having observed his external signs and (gestures). And the son of the windgod having come back, (Rama himself) went to Nandigrama.

sa: मयाभिपन्नं त्रायेरन् बलमास्थाय न त्रयः। युद्धार्हान् क्षत्रियान् सर्वान् पाण्डवेष्वाततायिनः॥
en: These three together cannot by their joint strength rescue a man in my power. All the Kshatriyas, who are fit for battle and who oppose the Pandavas.

sa: कालेन परिपक्वानि तावच्छाम्यतु वैशसम्। नकुलः सहदेवश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥
en: Which are ripening on their proper time having come, let hostilities cease. So long as Nakula and Sahadeva and Dhrishtadyumna, the son of Prishata,

sa: निवृत्तेनैव दोषेण तपोव्रतभिहाचरेत्। एतद् धातृकृतं वृत्तं सत्यमेव सतां व्रतम्॥
en: Being devoid of all vices, devotion and asceticism should be practiced here. It has been prescribed by God that truth shall constitute the vow of the righteous.

sa: संहत्य निहतो वृत्रो मरुद्भिर्वलापाणिना। नमुचिश्चैव दुर्धर्षो दीर्घजिह्वा च राक्षसी॥
en: (It was by adopting this path) that the wielder of the thunderbolt (Indra) together with the Marutas slew Vritra, the invincible Namuchi and the Rakshasa female Dirghajivha.

sa: यावन्न चरते मार्गान् पृतनामभिधर्षयन्। भीमसेनो गदापाणिस्तावत् संशाम्य पाण्डवैः॥
en: Let there be peace with Pandavas so long as Bhimasena, with the mace in his hands, does not come this way vanquishing his opponents.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धृतराष्ट्रवचः श्रुत्वा भीष्मद्रोणौ समव्यथौ। दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमूचतुः शासनातिगम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words of Dhritarashtra the two, sympathizing with Dhritarashtra said, word to Duryodhana who did not act according to the instructions of his elders.

sa: सनत्सुजात उवाच अपृच्छः कर्मणा केचिन्मृत्युर्नास्तीति चापरमु। शृणु मे ब्रुवतो राजन् यथैतन्मा विशङ्किथाः॥
en: Sanat-Sujata said You have asked how death is avoided by certain actions and how it does not exit at all. Listen to me, discoursing on this, and do not be moved by doubts for this (inconsistency).

sa: अचलं स्थानमासाद्य दौहित्रफलनिर्जितम्। कर्मभिः स्वैरुपचितो जज्वाल परया श्रिया॥
en: Reaching then eternal regions earned for him by his grand sons by the fruit of their own deeds, he became effulgent with excellent beauty.

sa: सुतेजनै रुक्मपुकैः सुधौतेर्नतपर्वभिः। आचितं पश्य कौन्तेयं कर्णिकारिवाचलम्॥
en: Struck by gold-feathered, strong, straight and powerful arrows, behold the son of Kunti adorned like a hill covered with Karnikara flowers.

sa: यथा मे भगवानाह नारदो देवस्तकृतः। संवत्सरेण सोऽल्पायुहन्यासं करिष्यति॥
en: The divine Narada, who is honoured by the celestials, tells me that within a year, he, of short life, will give up the ghost.

sa: चतुर्वर्षशतायुश्च त्वया सार्धमवाप्स्यति। इष्ट्वा यज्ञैश्च धर्मेण ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यति॥
en: He as well as you will live four hundred years. By his devoutness and by celebrating many sacrifices he will win a great renown in the world.

sa: द्रोणं व्यपदिशशिष्यो वासुदेवसहायवान्। भीतोऽस्मीति कथं ब्रूयां दधानो गाण्डिवं धनुः॥
en: Calling myself the pupil of Drona and getting the help of Vasudeva, how can I say that I am afraid especially as I hold the Gandiva bow?

sa: धारयन् गाण्डिवं दिव्यं धनुस्तेजोमयं दृढम्। अक्षय्यशरसंयुक्तो दिव्यास्त्रपरिबृहितः॥
en: And holding firmly the celestial bow the Gandiva and furnished with an inexhaustible mass of arrows and protected by celestial weapons,

sa: तथेति तं प्रतिज्ञाय मूषिका भरतर्षभ। वृद्धबालमथो सर्वं मार्जाराय न्यवेदयन्॥
en: The mice too saying "very well", O best among the race of Bharatas, placed every one of themselves, old and young, under the protection of the cat.

sa: युध्यामहे कथं संख्ये कोपयेव च पाण्डवान्॥ त्वत्कृते दुष्टभावस्य संत्यागो विदुरस्य च।
en: With the thought how can we engage in fight, how can we inspire anger into the sons of Pandu. It was on account of your doing that we cast off the wicked Vidura.

sa: जातुषे च गृहे दाहं स्मर तं पुरुषो भव॥ यच्च कृष्णमवोचस्त्वमायान्तं कुरुसंसदि।
en: Remembering the attempt to burn you up in a house of powered lac be a man (and fight) as you said to Krishna when he was coming to the assembly of the Kurus.

sa: घातयित्वा प्रदास्यामि पार्थेभ्यो राज्यमुत्तमम्। आचचक्षे च मे सर्वं संजयस्तव भाषितम्॥
en: That, killing in battle the son of Dhritarashtra I shall bestow an excellent kingdom on the sons of Pritha-Sanjaya informed me of everything that you saidमद्वितीयेन पार्थेन वैरं वः सव्यसाचिना।

sa: एवं कत्थसि कौन्तेय अकत्थन् पुरुषो भव। सूतपुत्रं सुदुर्धर्षं शल्यं च बलिनां वरम्॥
en: You too boast in the same way; O son of Kunti, show forth your manliness without boasting. The son of a Suta, excited with great wrath, and that foremost among persons endued with strength namely Shalya,

sa: अशक्तेन च यच्छप्तं भीमसेनेन पाण्डव। दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं पीयतां यदि शक्यते॥
en: O son of Pandu now let what had been said by O Bhimasena namely that he would drink the blood of Dushasana, be made good by him, if he can.
